sections.Description:
I have a bundle of hides from the animals of Mulgore, and must get them to Thunder Bluff. A colleague there, Ahanu, will use the hides to create leather goods.

Will you take the hides to him for me?

The quickest way to Thunder Bluff is on the back of a wind rider. Bring the bundle of hides to Tak, our wind rider master in Bloodhoof Village, and speak to him about transport to Thunder Bluff.
sections.Objectives:
Bring the Bundle of Hides to the wind rider master Tak in Bloodhoof Village.
- Bundle of Hides (provided)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 50 XP
- +25 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress: Are you here for a wind rider? You have something to transport?
sections.Completion: If you must take these hides to Thunder Bluff, then you have come to the right place.
sections.Notes: - This quest is Tauren only.

sections.Description:
All members of the tribe share in the harmony of life. We live together and work together.

Our commitment to one another carries with it a high degree of responsibility. I ask of you now a humble task.

My mother set out this morning to fetch water from the well to the southeast of Narache. It has been quite some time now. Perhaps you could check on her for me while I attend to tribal matters here?
sections.Objectives: Chief Hawkwind wants you to search for his mother near the water well to the southeast of Camp Narache.
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- - 85 XP (or a compensation at max level)
- +75 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Completion: You traveled all this way just to help an old woman? My my, aren't you a keeper?

sections.Description:
I have traveled many paths through life and these old legs lack the vigor they once had. I can still perform my duties to the tribe. Sometimes it just takes an old woman a little longer to do the task.

But you look like an eager . Let's put some of that youthful vitality to the test. Take a water pitcher from the well and bring it to my son, the Chief, in Camp Narache.

Remember that even the most humble task can gain the recognition of elders.
sections.Objectives:
Take a Water Pitcher from the water well.

Return the pitcher to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache which is northwest from the water well.
- Water Pitcher
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- - 250 XP (or at max level)
- +250 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress: You look as though you have returned from the plains. Do you have any word from Greatmother Hawkwind?
sections.Completion:
You carried this pitcher back at the Greatmother's bidding, I see.

Your willingness to help others and provide for the of Camp Narache leads me to believe you would make the tribe proud in Thunder Bluff someday.
sections.Notes: On accept

sections.Description:
Hunters are central to the Tauren way of life, . Our people look to us as both guardians and providers. Many times on your journey, you will alone in hostile territory, surviving only by your wits.

Not long ago, a fledgling hunter was experimenting with mystical runes to improve his combat prowess. He went out to test his new abilities on the Bristleback Battleboars to the east, but never returned.

Find his rune, and use it to learn a new combat technique. Return to me once you have done so.
sections.Objectives:
Find the missing rune by slaying Bristleback Battleboars in Brambleblade Ravine. Use the rune to learn a new ability, then report back to Lanka Farshot in Camp Narache.
- Learn Spell: Engrave Gloves - Chimera Shot (hunter rune)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 85 XP
- +50 reputation with Thunder Bluff
- Cracked Leather Gloves
sections.Progress: Have you found the rune, ?
sections.Completion:
Well done, . Applying the rune to your equipment will grant you powerful new abilities.

There are many such runes throughout Azeroth. Seek them out, as they will help along your journey.

info.name: A Sacred Burial
info.rewards: Cairne's First Breastplate or Cord of Tragic Memory or Slippers of Mourning or Waistband of Tragic Memory

sections.Description:
Only the most valiant tauren are laid to rest at Red Rocks, our sacred burial ground. It is an honor bestowed upon the great warriors who helped found and defend Thunder Bluff and those who have given their lives for the greater good of their tribes and chieftains.

But it appears a foul menace has made its way onto our holy land. A band of Bristleback Interlopers is ravaging the grave site and I am too old and past my prime to drive them away.

They must be driven off with force, .
sections.Objectives:
Lorekeeper Raintotem wants you to kill 8 Bristleback Interlopers at Red Rocks. 
- Bristleback Interloper slain (8)
sections.Rewards:
You will be able to choose one of these rewards:
- Cairne's First Breastplate
- Cord of Tragic Memory
- Slippers of Mourning
- Waistband of Tragic Memory

You will also receive:
- - 150 XP
- +150 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress: The Bristleback Interlopers must be driven away from our sacred burial ground, .
sections.Completion: Well done. You have sent those foul Bristlebacks a clear message. They will think twice before attempting to meddle in this holy spot again.

sections.Description:
I believe your guide was delivering a warning. The unrest within the spirit realm may be even more dire than first feared.

We must cross over at once, from a place with a strong bond to the spirit realm.

In ages past, tauren made pilgrimages to Sun Rock Retreat to engage in such a ritual. It is said that long ago, An'she himself kissed the mountain where the retreat now stands.

Meet me there and we will begin the crossing.
sections.Objectives: Meet with Spiritwalker Ussoh at Sun Rock Retreat in Stonetalon Mountains.
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- - 1,800 XP
sections.Completion: Shall we begin?
sections.Notes: Take a flying mount and fly to Stonetalon Mountains and then head to Sun Rock Retreat and meet up with Spiritwalker Ussoh and turn in the quest.

sections.Description: If you're looking for something to do, I hear there are mages in the settlements near capital cities - Razor Hill, Brill, Bloodhoof Village, and Falconwing Square - who have been recruiting egg hunters for help with some research they're doing. I'm not sure of the particulars, but I'm sure they'd tell you.
sections.Objectives: Talk to a Spring Gatherer in Razor Hill, Brill, Bloodhoof Village, or Falconwing Square.
sections.Completion: Yes! Yes, I think I have just the task for you...

info.name: A Task Unfinished
info.rewards: 5xTough Hunk of Bread or 5xRefreshing Spring Water

sections.Description:
, please, I beg of you, can you help me? I have not finished my tasks here on the Mesa—I'm in the middle of my Rite of Strength—and my father asked me to deliver these furs to the inn in Bloodhoof.

I'm far from rested enough to complete both my rite and this task for my father. Would you mind going on for me?

The inn is pleasant and a perfect place to rest during your long travels. I'm sure you'll agree once you see it.
sections.Objectives:
Bring the Bundle of Furs to Innkeeper Kauth in Bloodhoof Village.
- Bundle of Furs (provided)
sections.Rewards:
You will be able to choose one of these rewards:
- 5x Tough Hunk of Bread
- 5x Refreshing Spring Water

You will also receive:
- 110 XP (or at max level)
- +25 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress:
Yes, young one? What can Kauth do for you?

The journey here from the Mesa can be a tremendous burden for some, but a welcome sight for others. Which is it for you, I wonder?
sections.Completion:
Ah, the furs I was expecting. Thank you.

These came faster than I had expected. They will make good blankets for anyone who wishes to stay here.

Please feel free to stay as long as you like. My inn is always open and all of our people are welcome here. And don't underestimate a good night's rest, it can make a great difference while you're out traveling.

sections.Progress:
You might not realize this, but running a traveling carnival is costly! Everything wears down so fast it's a wonder we can turn a profit.

Because of all those hidden costs, we're always looking for ways to maintain our equipment as cheaply as possible. Our tents, for instance, tear regularly but I've found that leather armor kits make great patches. Can you find and bring me some armor kits? That'll save us a bundle! Do that, and I have a fistful of Darkmoon Faire tickets for you... 
- Rugged Armor Kit (8)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 20x Darkmoon Faire Prize Ticket
- +250 reputation with
sections.Completion:
Great! This will work great! I just noticed a rip in a tent over yonder, and one of these armor kits is just what I need to patch it up!

Thank you very much, . These armor kits will save us a ton in repair costs. Here are your tickets - you deserve them!

sections.Description:
After carefully evaluating the map, you realize that what you discovered are the plans made by the Bristleback warchief for an extended siege on Camp Narache.

Surely Chief Hawkwind could use this information!
sections.Objectives:
Bring the Bristleback Attack Plans to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache.
- Bristleback Attack Plans (provided)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 360 XP
- Thick Bark Buckler
- +250 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress: You have a look of concern about you, . What news do you bring?
sections.Completion: This is quite alarming indeed! But with this information we can call on our brethren from Bloodhoof Village to help thwart the attack. You have saved the lives of many , .
sections.Notes:
- The map can be found in a cave in Brambleblade Ravine. If you are standing outside Chief Sharptusk's hut facing the door and turn to your right, you will see a path leading up to a cave. The map is on the floor of the cave.
- When you right-click on the map to start the quest, it will turn into the Battleplans.

sections.Progress:
For my act as the strongest woman alive, I plan to accept items from the audience and smash them with a big, black mace!

Can you make me a big black mace, ? 
- Big Black Mace
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- +250 reputation with 
- 12x Darkmoon Faire Prize Ticket
sections.Completion:
Ah, perfect! This mace has a big, heavy head on it. I bet I could smash just about anything with it. I just hope I don't break it along with whatever I swing it against!

Here are your tickets, . Enjoy your stay at the faire!

sections.Description:
- I have heard of you, newcomer. Perhaps it is you that will help us, where others have failed.

We tauren have carved a home out of this land, but not without a cost. The Bristleback quilboars of Brambleblade Ravine, led by Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle, have made our lives difficult with their continued war against us. I charge you to bring me the chief's head!

He will be found in the ravine to the east in their makeshift village.
sections.Objectives:
Bring the head of Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle to Brave Windfeather in Red Cloud Mesa.
- Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle's Head
sections.Rewards:
You will be able to choose one of these rewards:
- Painted Chain Leggings
- Nomadic Gloves

You will also receive:
- 675 XP (or at max level)
- +500 reputation with
sections.Progress:
Sharptusk will trouble us no more once you have brought me proof of his death. It is his head that I seek, .

We live for the hunt, and there is no greater hunt than against one that is cunning enough to perhaps hunt us back. If you are successful in this task, young one, you will start to learn what I mean.
sections.Completion:
Justice has been served on this day by your swift actions, . Let this deed serve as a warning to all who would threaten our home.

You have earned this reward to help you on your sojourn, young .

sections.Description:
A sapta is a drink created to bind our spirits to the elements. Fused with magic, the potion will allow the open minded to see the elements as no one has seen them before. Your spirit will forever be tied to the element the sapta was created for, and only a select few of our kind know the secrets of its creation.

The sapta is always imbibed in a holy place, and never anywhere else.

Seek out the shaman shrine to the east of here and drink of the sapta.
sections.Objectives:
Find Kodo Rock and drink the Earth Sapta.
- Earth Sapta (provided)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 180 XP
sections.Completion:
Ah... ... pleased is the earth to have you here.

Bound together in body and spirit, you will go forward knowing that the mountains are your strength; the plains, your patience; and the world itself your essence.

Standing before the earth humbly is all that is required of you for you to pass this rite. But the others are not as passive. They may be chaotic and often violent, but such is the nature of the elements. Dual natures opposing one another, you must come to learn these things intricately.
sections.Notes:
- In case you lost the Earth Sapta, you could get it back through Earth Sapta (Mulgore).
- Kodo Rock could be difficult to find. The rock was a huge pillar of rock, but due to the way World of Warcraft draws objects, it won't fade into view until you are close to it. You should be able to head east from the well near Camp Narache and go straight to Kodo Rock (53,80).

info.name: Call of Earth
info.rewards: Earth Totem Strength of Earth Totem

sections.Description:
Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Seer Ravenfeather as proof of our meeting. She will craft a totem for you, and this pebble will be the heart of it. As small as it may seem, you will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest of things can outlast mountains.

Be patient, . Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what earth asks of you. In the end, you shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect you.
sections.Objectives:
Bring the Rough Quartz to Seer Ravenfeather in Camp Narache.
- Rough Quartz (provided)
sections.Rewards:
You will also receive:
- 445 XP

The following spell will be cast on you: Strength of Earth Totem
sections.Progress:
Greetings, . You would not return to me if you had not accomplished your task. May I be the first to welcome you fully to the first path of four that will forever rule your travels.

If you have the stone the earth gave to you, I will give you the totem it promised. If not, then I pity you. There is much pride to be had when you've fully dedicated yourself to the elements.
sections.Completion:
Splendid.

The totem I will craft for you is more than a symbol--it has abilities beyond that. One use of the totem is a focus for spells. Those spells are tied to the earth, and as you earn greater and greater wisdom, more of the earth's abilities will be made accessible to you. Trainers found throughout Kalimdor will know when you are ready for greater knowledge and will let you know as much when you visit them.

But for now, take this earth totem, and a scroll to teach you your first ability.
sections.Notes: - The Earth Totem was needed to cast any Earth-based totem. Always keep this in your inventory.
sections.Progression:
- Call of Earth (Mulgore)
- Call of Earth (Mulgore 2)
- Call of Earth (Mulgore 3)

sections.Description:
The time has come, young . Your body ages and grows strong, and your spirit endures like the earth. I see it within you-you have wisdom already.

The earth guides our people, and it speaks to us, as it will to you in time. But you must be tested. If you are ready, then you shall see things only our kind know of.

Seek out the Bristleback shamans in their ravine to the east, and take from them a salve they use in their rituals. Return to me only when you have enough for your own potion.
sections.Objectives:
Bring 2 applications of Ritual Salve to Seer Ravenfeather in Camp Narache.
- Ritual Salve (2)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 270 XP
sections.Progress:
The earth is patient, and will wait for you until you are ready because she knows in time all things erode and are reborn. It is the cycle of things. Mountains become deserts. Rivers become canyons. The earth is the most stubborn and wise of all the elements.

You must learn patience and stamina above all things. The earth calls for you now because she feels you are ready. Consider this your rebirth if you succeed. You will never be able to go back to ignorance afterwards.
sections.Completion:
Good, . Your return here signifies that you are indeed prepared for the next step.

Of all the elements, earth represents the foundation of all things. It is your strength, your stamina, and your patience. The Earth Mother will protect you, but only if you show her proper respect. She is the basis for life, and by observing her laws, you will gain a greater wisdom. Never forget the secrets she shares with you.

I shall make your sapta for you now, and by accepting it, a new path will open before you.
sections.Notes: - Dropped from Bristleback Shaman.

- Call of Earth (Mulgore 3)

sections.Description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, . The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
sections.Objectives:
Speak with in to learn to become a cook.
- Learn cooking from in
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 270 XP
sections.Progress: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.
sections.Completion:
With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.

Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.

sections.Progress:
We at the Darkmoon Faire do much walking. We walk from one faire site to another... in fact, you'll never see us sitting down on the job! So it is no surprise that we wear out quite a lot of boots! We need boots that are both durable and stylish, and embossed leather boots fit that bill rather well.

You! You're a leatherworker; make me embossed leather boots and I'll give you a Darkmoon Faire ticket for the work.
- Embossed Leather Boots (3)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- +250 reputation with 
- 1x Darkmoon Faire Prize Ticket
sections.Completion: Thank you, . These are quite well made. The craftsmanship is top notch! Here is a Darkmoon Faire ticket... enjoy, sir.

sections.Progress:
Our Faire workers do more than sweep trash and hammer spikes! They also help guard the carnival as it travels, and to that end they are always needing good sturdy armor jerkins.

If you make some tough leather armor and bring it to me, then I'll make sure it gets to the right people. I'll also get you some Darkmoon Faire tickets as trade. 
- Toughened Leather Armor (3)

You will receive:

sections.Completion:
Ah, you brought the jerkins. Splendid. What animal's skin did you use to make these, may I ask? The stitch-work is very well done, and the texture of the leather has a rugged style to it. I can tell you are a craftsman of skill!

Thank you, , and here are your tickets.

sections.Progress:
It takes a lot of work to be the strongest woman alive! My weight set is getting too light and if I'm too stay fit then I'll need more weights!

Do you think you could bring me to some weight stones? If you do, then I'll give you a Darkmoon Faire ticket.
- Coarse Weightstone (10)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- Darkmoon Faire Prize Ticket
- +250 reputation with
sections.Completion:
Great! These will work great! They're not too heavy, but not too light either. They're perfect for building muscle mass!

Thanks much, . Here's your Darkmoon Faire ticket!
sections.Notes: See Darkmoon Faire Reputation for details of this quest's availability.

sections.Progress:
Yebb is developing a new attraction for the Zoo Bizarre, one that will drive people crazy with wonder, and delight! But it will take a lot of work, and a lot of materials...

That includes Copper Modulators. We need lots of modulators for the mechanical parts of the attraction. Bring me copper modulators and I'll trade for them with a Darkmoon Faire ticket.
- Copper Modulator (5)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 1x Darkmoon Faire Prize Ticket
- +250 reputation with Darkmoon Faire
sections.Completion:
Aha! The modulators! Superb!

I can't tell you exactly what we're building, but these will be invaluable for its construction. I am in your debt, , but please, take this Darkmoon Faire ticket as a token of my appreciation.
sections.Notes:
This quest is no longer available after you reach 500 reputation. This is two turn ins.

See also Darkmoon Faire quests involving engineered items.

title: Crocolisk Boy and the Bearded Murloc

info.name: Crocolisk Boy and the Bearded Murloc

sections.Progress:
Yebb is working on other attractions for his zoo, including wet, swampy abodes for a boy raised by crocolisks, and perhaps for a murloc. We will need nice, water-tight leggings so we won't get waterlogged during prop-ups and tear-downs. For that job, I think turtlescale leggings will do the trick.

, can you make those leggings? If you do, then a fat stack of Darkmoon Faire tickets will be your reward... 
- Turtle Scale Leggings
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 12x Darkmoon Faire Prize Ticket
- +250 reputation with
sections.Completion:
Great, you made them! These will do nicely... I just hope I won't be the one to clean the crocolisk cage when the time comes. Those beasts can be rather beastly, don't you think?

Here are your tickets, . Enjoy them, and enjoy your stay at the Darkmoon Faire!

title: Dangers of the Windfury

sections.Description:
Thank you for taking the time to speak to me, . I am Ruul, warrior and teacher.

You have obviously reached an age when you must prepare for your trials if you are to adventure much further out of Mulgore.

If you wish a test of your strength, start by seeking out the Windfury harpies to the southeast. They nestle along the mountain's edges away from the road.

They are one of our natural enemies here in Mulgore and will be a good gauge of your skill.
sections.Objectives: Bring 8 Windfury Talons to Ruul Eagletalon in Bloodhoof Village.
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- - 200 XP
- +250 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress: The Windfuries are deadly foes. Their strength in battle is only rivaled by their desire for fresh meat.
sections.Completion: You have done well, . You seem well prepared to travel onward. Let the wind always be at your back.

On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded." You have heard that this faire alternately stops at and Goldshire every few weeks, so you will have to wait until they are here next.

- 390 XP

sections.Progress: I see that you have managed to complete a deck of dunes! Congratulations!
sections.Completion: So you have put together a deck of Dunes. Your gesture of returning it to us will create a tie between you and the Darkmoon that will not soon be forgotten. Allow me to present you with one of the greater darkmoon cards as a small token of our appreciation.

sections.Description:
There are dwarves preparing a dig site to the northwest. They think secrets lie in the earth, and that is true, but hollowing and defiling the land is no way to earn its teachings.

Collect the dwarven tools of digging, smash them, and return to me with the dwarves' broken tools.

You can smash the tools at a forge. You will find one in Thunder Bluff, but any forge—even a forge at the dwarven camp—will suffice.
sections.Objectives:
Collect 5 Prospector's Picks.

At a forge, smash the Prospector's Picks to create Broken Tools.

Bring 5 Broken Tools to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village.
- Broken Tools (5)
sections.Rewards:
Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
- 700 XP (or at level 70)
- +250 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress: Hello, . Do you have the Broken Tools? The dwarves' digging will enrage the kodos of Mulgore. This defilement must be stopped!
sections.Completion: Thank you, . This will calm the beasts of Mulgore. And, spirits willing, it will teach the dwarves that hollowing the land is not the path to knowledge.

sections.Description: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, . I believe she was sent by the hunter trainer Lanka. If this note is from Lanka, I wouldn't take long in reading its contents.
sections.Objectives:
Read the[Etched Note and speak to Lanka Farshot in Camp Narache.
- Etched Note (provided)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 130 XP
- +75 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress:
Welcome to Camp Narache, . I hear good things about you. Your bloodline is strong, and many of the elders consider you skilled already. But that we will test.

The plains of Mulgore will be your home for sometime—you should do your best to learn it very well. One day you will travel to unfamiliar lands to master greater skills. You must be ready.
sections.Completion:
And it is my job to make sure you are prepared by teaching you the basics of our profession—how to tame your pet, how to fire your rifle, and many other skills that will become necessary.

Hunters are a strong part of our tradition and history, . You would do well to remember how important you are to the tribe. You will be respected and revered if you serve our people well.

sections.Progress:
Do you ever find yourself wandering in a cave, late at night, looking for adventure? You do? Really? Well, then you've seen the creepy eyes of bats staring at you from high up, waiting for you to let down your guard so they can suck your blood!

Scary thought, don't you think? Of course! It's no doubt that bat eyes are scary!

Will you bring me some evil bat eyes, ? I want them for... something I'm designing. Something scary.

You can get them from the bats of the Eastern Plaguelands.
- Evil Bat Eye (10)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 20x Darkmoon Faire Prize Ticket
- +250 reputation with
sections.Completion:
Great! You got the eyes! I hope hunting those bats was frightening for you, because if it scared a brave like yourself, then those eyes will certainly scare our Faire visitors. 

Take these tickets, , and thank you for your service.

sections.Description:
We must do more than simply hunt boars here. The eyesore that has been left upon the land must be purged.

To give them a wild thirst for blood, the battleboars are force-fed raw flesh. Take this torch, and use it to burn the troughs of meat and gore to cinders.
sections.Objectives:
Use Adana's Torch to set fire to all 3 Troughs in the Battleboar Pens.
- First Trough
- Second Trough
- Third Trough
- Adana's Torch (provided)
sections.Rewards: You will receive:
sections.Progress: Have all the troughs been burned?
sections.Completion: You've not only wiped the boar pens clean, but put a stop to a horrible desecration. Well done.
sections.Notes:
This quest should be done at the same time as The Battleboars (2).

Burning the troughs usually kills several boars, effectively reducing the amount of boars you'll need to kill for The Battleboars.

sections.Progress:
In all my time working the Faire, I've learned a lot of things about customers. Here's one of those nuggets of wisdom: customers love stuff that glows! It doesn't matter what it is - you could take a broken chair leg and make it glow, and every child will come from miles around to get one!

So, , I need glowing scorpid blood. You can find it from the scorpids of Tanaris, Silithus, Blasted Lands, or the Burning Steppes. 
- Glowing Scorpid Blood (10)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 20x Darkmoon Faire Prize Ticket
- +250 reputation with
sections.Completion:
Great job, ! Thanks a lot! I'm going to make paint from this blood and turn all kinds of cheap junk into glowing treasure!

Here are your tickets, and thanks again!
sections.Notes: See Darkmoon Faire Reputation for details of this quest's availability.

info.name: Go to Adana
info.next: Rite of Courage Stop the Thorncallers

sections.Description:
We've struck a great blow against the quilboar here. I will stay here, and hold the line, but you need to move on.

Seek Adana Thunderhorn; she has taken a few braves to the southwest to root out the rest of the Bristleback.
sections.Objectives: Go to Adana Thunderhorn to the Southwest.
sections.Rewards: You will receive:
sections.Completion: More trials lay ahead, . I hope you're prepared.

sections.Progress:
When I finally get this booth up and running, I'll want to advertise! And what better way is there to advertise then with fireworks?

Well, some might think that the smell of a cauldron, churning with the boiling heads of your foes is better for drawing crowds, but... we're in mixed company. So fireworks it will have to be!

Bring me green fireworks, , and I have a big fistful of Darkmoon Faire tickets for you.
- Green Firework (36)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 8x Darkmoon Faire Prize Ticket
- +250 reputation with
sections.Completion:
You brought the fireworks. Wonderful work, ! I can't wait to light these and tell the world that my booth is ready to go! I must still wait, quite a long time I'm afraid, but... I'll be ready when I'm ready, yes?

Here are the tickets, . Enjoy yourself!
sections.Notes:
See Darkmoon Faire Reputation for details of this quest's availability.

As 3 fireworks are made per set of materials, 12 Heavy Leather and 12 Heavy Blasting Powder are required.

sections.Progress:
I'm working on a new costume, for when I have my own booth as the strongest woman alive! Right now I'm looking for some bracers I can wear. They can't cover much because people want to see my muscles, but I still want to flash a little color, you know?

How about green iron bracers, ? Can you make me green iron bracers? If you can, then I have a whole bunch of Darkmoon Faire tickets for you. 
- Green Iron Bracers (3)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 8x Darkmoon Faire Prize Ticket
- +250 reputation with
sections.Completion:
Yes! These are exactly what I need! Such a lovely color, and they still leave my arms bare so you can see how strong they are! Perfect!

Here you are, . Here are your tickets - enjoy!
sections.Notes: See Darkmoon Faire Reputation for details of this quest's availability.

sections.Description: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, . I believe she was sent by the priest trainer, Seer Ravenfeather. If this note is from the seer, I would go looking for her immediately.
sections.Objectives:
Read the Hallowed Note and speak to Seer Ravenfeather in Camp Narache.
- Hallowed Note (provided)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 130 XP
- +75 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress: I am pleased to meet you, .
sections.Completion: You have arrived at last. During your training in Camp Narache, I will guide you in the ways of the priest. You have much to learn and I look forward to counting you among my students.

sections.Description:
I want to teach you a versatile and quick healing technique, . This heal is one you will find yourself using often.

There is no lack of braves injured in our battles against the Bristlebacks, so you'll have a chance to put your new knowledge to use right away. Practice your new healing technique on the wounded braves around Camp Narache.
sections.Objectives:
Learn Flash Heal from Seer Ravenfeather. Practice using Flash Heal 5 times on Wounded Braves in Camp Narache.
- Heal Wounded Brave (5)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 130 XP
- +75 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Completion: Thank you for your help in seeing to the wounded braves. I'm sure that you will often find your healing skills in demand. Return to me when you need further instruction.

sections.Progress:
To help with my workout, I like to fit a staff between heavy grinding stones, then lift the staff over my head. It isn't easy, but being the strongest woman in the world, like I am, can't be earned sitting down!

Can you help me? I need more grinding stones - bring me some and I'll trade Darkmoon Faire tickets for them. 
- Heavy Grinding Stone (7)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 4x Darkmoon Faire Prize Ticket
- +250 reputation with
sections.Completion:
You brought the stones! And they're heavy! I can already feel my muscles getting bigger. Thanks !

Here, take these tickets, and be sure not to eat too many sweets while you're at the faire. A big strong like you needs to keep himself in fighting shape!
sections.Notes: See Darkmoon Faire Reputation for details of this quest's availability.

sections.Description:
Shamanism is an ancient practice, . Many artifacts, full of spiritual energy, can be found across Azeroth. I had recently discovered an icon of notable power myself, but it was stolen by the quilboar.

Go to their territory, to the east, and find the stolen icon. It is likely being carried by one of their own shamans attempting to understand its secrets.

Once you find the icon, learn its power and return to me.
sections.Objectives:
Recover the lost icon from the Bristleback Shamans in Brambleblade Ravine. Learn its power, then report back to Harutt Thunderhorn in Camp Narache.
- Learn Spell: Engrave Chest - Overload
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 90 XP
- Cracked Leather Vest
- +50 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress: Have you found the icon, ?
sections.Completion:
Well done, . Applying the rune to your equipment will grant you powerful new abilities.

There are many such runes throughout Azeroth. Seek them out, as they will help along your journey.

sections.Description:
The warriors of the Horde have much to teach you, , but you must also seek out new techniques on your own.

As you may know, there is a group of hostile quilboars to the east. Another fledgling warrior ventured into their territory some time ago, and never returned. He was experimenting with engraving mystical runes onto his equipment to improve his combat prowess.

Find the rune among the quilboar and learn this technique yourself. Return to me when you have done so.
sections.Objectives:
Recover the lost rune from Brambleblade Ravine. Use the rune to learn a new ability, then report back to Harutt Thunderhorn in Camp Narache.
- Learn Spell: Engrave Gloves - Victory Rush (warrior rune)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 85 XP
- +50 reputation with Thunder Bluff
- Tarnished Chain Gloves
sections.Progress: Have you found the rune, ?
sections.Completion:
Well done, . Applying the rune to your equipment will grant you powerful new abilities.

There are many such runes throughout Azeroth. Seek them out, as they will help along your journey.

sections.Description:
The wells are cleansed, and Mulgore's waters run sweet and clear once more. You've saved us...but you've also uncovered grim happenings. The actions of the Grimtotem must be made known.

It is time for you to enter Thunder Bluff, our great city atop the mesa. Go to our leader, Baine Bloodhoof, son of Cairne. He must hear of this.
sections.Objectives: Speak with Baine Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
sections.Completion:
Welcome to Thunder Bluff, . You've done great things for our people.

Tell me of your journey.

sections.Description:
You will now be revered within our great city. Any worthy of completing the Rites of the Earthmother earns that honor.

For your final quest, seek out our noble leader, Cairne Bloodhoof, who dwells atop the highest mesa in Thunder Bluff.
sections.Objectives: Speak with Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 420 XP
- +75 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Completion: Hail, young . I see you found your way to my doorstep.
sections.Notes: - Cairne Bloodhoof can be found on High Rise in Thunder Bluff.

sections.Description:
I have foreseen your arrival, young . Though perhaps you are not so young anymore.

I think that it is time for you to move deeper into this land. I can sense that you are destined for great things.

It is the Crossroads that you must seek out, for our lives with the orcs have become intertwined and they need assistance. Continue down this road towards the east and follow it north to the Crossroads. Find Thork within its walls, he has the Earthmother's blessing.
sections.Objectives: Speak with Thork at the Crossroads in the Barrens.
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 230 XP (or at max level)
- +25 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Completion: It is good to see that more of our allies have come to assist us from as far away as Thunder Bluff. Again, I welcome you.

sections.Description:
Help, ! My prized puppy, Kyle, has run away! I just know he's running around Bloodhoof Village, lost and hungry.

Will you find him and feed him? Once he eats he will settle down and come home.

To feed him you will need to find food. His favorite meal is tender strider meat. Just venture east and you should find plenty of striders. Hunt one down and take its succulent meat to Kyle. When you see Kyle in town, put the meat down and he is sure to come to you.
sections.Objectives:
Ahab Wheathoof at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore wants you to feed his prized puppy, Kyle the Frenzied.

Feed Kyle Tender Strider Meat and return to Ahab Wheathoof.
- Kyle fed
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- - 200 XP
- +250 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress: Did you find Kyle?
sections.Completion: Fantastic work, ! Kyle came home as soon as he ate and went straight to bed. Thank you for your help.
sections.Notes and trivia:
Kyle the Frenzied runs in a wide circle in Bloodhoof Village. When he is nearby, click on the Tender Strider Meat to make Kyle stop and eat.
This quest was created by Tigole at the behest of Ezra Chatterton, who toured Blizzard's offices with the Make-a-Wish Foundation.

sections.Description:
The camp is safe, and the quilboar driven off, all thanks to you, young one. You have my personal thanks for what you have done for my mother, my son, and for all of us.

It is now time to put Greatmother Hawkwind to rest. Lay the final offering at her feet, , and we will say our goodbyes.
sections.Objectives:
Use the Ceremonial Offering at Greatmother Hawkwind's grave.
- Offering Placed
- Water Pitcher (2) (provided)
sections.Progress: Do not be shy, . I am honored to have you lay the final offering.
sections.Completion: There is balance in all things. As Greatmother Hawkwind's spirit takes its final journey, you will begin your first.
sections.Notes: Upon accepting the quest:

sections.Description:
This pamphlet advertising riding training and mount purchases was sent from Kar Stormsinger.

Kar can be found in Mulgore's Bloodhoof Village.
sections.Objectives:
Return the pamphlet to Kar Stormsinger at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore.
- Riding Training Pamphlet (Provided)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 395 XP
sections.Progress: Ah, you received my letter? Good.
sections.Completion: So, shall we begin your Apprentice Riding training?

sections.Description: As you become more skilled, your skills will expand, and you will gain access to many new powers. Go - get some experience out there, and come back to me when you've learned something new. You can demonstrate on the training dummies nearby.
sections.Objectives:
Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain. Practice using it 5 times on Training Dummies in Camp Narache.
- Practice Shadow Word: Pain (5)
sections.Completion: Thank you for your help in seeing to the wounded braves. I'm sure that you will often find your healing skills in demand. Return to me when you need further instruction.

info.name: Mazzranache
info.rewards: Belt of the Prairie Wolf or Cougar Pelt Wristwraps or Swoopskin Gloves or Prairie Wolf Bracers

sections.Description:
My grandfather told me stories about his battles with a strider named Mazzranache. He told me of its demonic red eyes, razor-sharp talons and venomous bite.

As fortune would have it, while traveling across the plains, I encountered it, and it took a nasty bite from my shoulder. He was as terrible as my grandfather described. I have gathered all the parts of the remedy I need to cure myself... except a flatland cougar femur.

I grow weaker by the moment... please, help me.
sections.Objectives:
Bring a Flatland Cougar Femur to Maur Raincaller at Bloodhoof Village.
- Flatland Cougar Femur
sections.Rewards:
You will also receive:
- - 200 XP
- +250 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress:
My fever grows worse and I find my mind drifting into delirious nightmares... I should have known that I wouldn't be able to handle a beast my grandfather was unable to defeat...

Do you have the ingredients for the remedy? I fear if I do not clean the infection soon, it will be the death of me.
sections.Completion:
Ah, thank you, . Using the items you brought me, I will be able to create the remedy I need to stop the spread of the infection and, eventually, cure it completely. I owe you my life in thanks.

But I'll never forget that screeching call when Mazzranache came upon me, the blaze of color as its beak descended...

Be wary on your travels.
sections.Notes:
If playing a tauren, the quest Thunderhorn Totem should be done at the same time, as both require items dropped by Flatland Cougars.

Prior to Cataclysm, this quest was much more difficult, requiring the collection of four rare dropped items instead of one.

sections.Progress:
The biggest reason I can't open up my booth is that... everything's broken! I need mechanical repair kits to fix all this stuff!
Can you bring me those kits, ? I'll trade you... kits for Darkmoon Faire tickets. What do you say? 
- Mechanical Repair Kit (6)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 12x Darkmoon Faire Prize Ticket
- +250 reputation with
sections.Completion:
Thank you! Now I can get to fixing things.

It's going to take a lot of repair kits and a lot of late nights to get everything in working order. Sometimes I think it'd be better to get back to my roots and restart my career as a headhunter, but... the Faire has been good to me.

Take these tickets, , and have fun!
sections.Notes: See Darkmoon Faire Reputation for details of this quest's availability.

sections.Objectives:
, I must thank you for all your help. I have plenty of supplies, through no small efforts on your part, but if you wish to bring me more armor kits, then I will gladly trade them for Darkmoon Faire tickets. 
- Rugged Armor Kit (8)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 20x Darkmoon Faire Prize Ticket
sections.Completion: There you are, . A fair trade. Enjoy.
sections.Notes: See Darkmoon Faire Reputation for details of this quest's availability.

sections.Progress:
, the attraction I'm designing will be the scariest event since Gnomeregan was overrun! And it's largely thanks to you and all the baubles you've brought me. Many, many thanks!

I don't need much else, but... if you bring me more evil bat eyes from the bats of the Eastern Plaguelands... I might have more Darkmoon Faire tickets for you. 
- Evil Bat Eye (10)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 20x Darkmoon Faire Prize Ticket
sections.Completion: Thanks again, . Here are your tickets!
sections.Notes: See Darkmoon Faire Reputation for details of this quest's availability.

sections.Progress:
, thank you for all the help you've given me. I really can't thank you enough!

Although my need is no longer great... if you bring me more dense grinding stones, I still have more Darkmoon Faire tickets for you.
- Dense Grinding Stone (8)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 20x Darkmoon Faire Prize Ticket
sections.Completion: Again, thank you . Please enjoy these tickets, and tell your friends about the Darkmoon Faire!
sections.Notes: See Darkmoon Faire Reputation for details of this quest's availability.

sections.Progress:
That scorpid blood is working out great, ! It's amazing how a little sparkle and shine can create a prized bauble out of an otherwise piece of junk. The patrons love the stuff, and love
is what it's all about, don't you think...

You've been a big help to me, , and although I don't have a great need for more glowing scorpid blood, if you bring me more then I'll still trade you some tickets. 
- Glowing Scorpid Blood (10)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 20x Darkmoon Faire Prize Ticket
sections.Completion: Thanks again, . Here are your tickets!
sections.Notes: See Darkmoon Faire Reputation for details of this quest's availability.

sections.Progress:
, you have been so good to us, bringing me goods without tiring. You have my eternal thanks!

Although our need for Thorium widgets is not as great as it was, you may still bring them to me and I will gladly trade them for Darkmoon Faire tickets.
- Thorium Widget (6)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 20x Darkmoon Faire Prize Ticket
sections.Completion: Here you are, . Here are Darkmoon Faire tickets for your enjoyment. Do not, as they say, spend them all in one place!

sections.Description:
You may have heard of the Venture Company. They are a goblin "cartel", something like a tribe.

While one of these cartels has joined us in the Horde, the Venture Company is loyal only to greed. These greedy goblins and their workers have tried to exploit the resources of Mulgore before, to little success.

One of our outrunners, Morin Cloudstalker, has gone to check the remains of one of the goblin caravans. If you wish to help him, follow the road out of the village to the east.

- Speed level of the Tauren. Performed using a hunter.

- Hearthstone
- Turn in "The Battleboars", "Break Sharptusk!" and "Rite of Strength" Accept "Rites of the Earthmother" pt2.
- Run down the road and accept "A Task Unfinished"

- Turn in "Rites of the Earthmother." Accept "Sharing the Land", "Rite of Vision", and "Dwarven Digging."
- Go to the inn and turn in "A Task Unfinished" Make Bloodhoof Village your home.
- Also accept "Dangers of the Windfury", "Swoop Hunting", "Mazzranache", and "Poison Water."
- Turn in "Rite of Vision" and accept it again.
- Go do "Sharing the Land" along with "Poison Water." Try to kill any swoops you see for "Swoop hunting."
- You will be collecting the items for "Mazzranache" as you do other quests.

- Get the remaining items for "Mazzranache."
- Turn in all quests at Bloodhoof Village.
- If you couldn't get to a forge to break the digging tools, just save them for now.
- Accept "Thunderhorn Cleansing." Do it and turn it in. Accept "Wildmane Totem."
- Go east and accept "The Ravaged Caravan." Go north, complete it, and turn it in. Accept "The Venture Co" and "Supervisor Fizsprocket."

- When this is complete, tame a Prarie Wolf Alpha for Bite rank 2. This will be your primary pet (ignore instruction to tame Savannah Huntress later.)
- ...unless you are lucky and find The Rake, at some point, in which case abandon your pet without hesitation and tame The Rake.
- (if you tame The Rake ignore any instruction to change your primary pet to Savannah Huntress or Stranglethorn Tiger)

- Accept "The Hunter's Way." (this is not a hunter quest)

- Go north of Thunder Bluff and complete "The Hunter's Way."

- Run to Crossroads. Turn in all quests, and get the flight path.
- Run to Orgrimmar to get Bow Training.
- After getting weapon training in Orgrimmar, fly back to Crossroads and continue from there.

sections.Description:
Mulgore is a level 1—10 zone for Horde players. Players travel through the zone, battling the quilboar and completing the Rites of the Earthmother to become true tauren braves.

Unlike many other non-instanced starting areas (which, for the most part, can be done by any race), more than half of Mulgore storyline is only doable by tauren characters.
sections.Bloodhoof Village: Picking up from Tauren starting experience, in Bloodhoof Village there are numerous quests that players can complete to help the tauren of that village before beginning the main quest line for Mulgore. In this quest line the sacred wells of Mulgore have been poisoned by the nefarious Grimtotem tribe. Under the direction of Ahmo Thunderhorn, players gather the necessary materials to create totems and then use those totems to cleanse the wells of the corruption - beating back the Grimtotem tauren who try to prevent that. After cleansing both the Winterhoof well and the Thunderhorn well, players are sent onward to Camp Sungraze via the Rite of Vision to cleanse the final well. A side quest line has players fighting against the Goblins of the Venture Co. who are trying to drive the tauren from the land so that they can use it for profit.
sections.Camp Sungraze:
Continuing with the main Mulgore quest line, players cleanse the final well - the Wildmane well - and then travel to Thunder Bluff to tell Baine Bloodhoof of what has transpired. Enraged, Baine orders all Grimtotem expelled from Mulgore and he personally slays Orno Grimtotem, leader of the Grimtotem. There are a couple of other side quests in Camp Sungraze, including one which clears the quillboar out from the sacred Red Rocks burial ground. After completing all quests, players can complete the final Rite of the Earth Mother, the Rite of Wisdom. Finally the quest Walk With The Earth Mother brings players onwards to Orgrimmar.

After that, the player ends up right next to Gotura Fourwinds, who sends the player to Northern Barrens. Alternatively, a quest the player might have picked up in Thunder Bluff leads to Silverpine Forest:
- Preserving the Barrens
- Until Death Do Us Part

Despite their size, the Bristleback greatly outnumber us. A pack ambush can easily overwhelm even the largest tauren.

Many new initiates have taken up arms to defend our home. Some have given their lives, but others have been captured alive.

, my brother soon stands before Chief Bloodhoof, and it is my honor to make his headdress for him.

sections.Description:
Working the Darkmoon Faire is a dangerous job, . It's no surprise that many of our workers get injured setting up, taking down, and transporting all of its attractions.

Some of the injured workers can be found around here, near the wagons. Others have gone to the healing tent for treatment. Would you take these bandages and see if you can help any of the injured workers?

sections.Description:
The Tauren are an ancient people, , and our lost relics can be found across Azeroth. Through them, the spirits can teach you ways to strengthen your connection to the Dream.

The bristleback quilboar have stolen one such relic from us. They have likely stashed it away within Brambleblade Ravine. Recover the relic, and follow its guidance to learn a new combat technique. Return to me when you have done this.
sections.Objectives:
Recover the stolen relic from Brambleblade Ravine. Follow the relic's guidance to learn a new ability, then report back to Gart Mistrunner in Camp Narache.
- Learn Spell: Engrave Chest - Fury of Stormrage (druid rune)

sections.Progress: What has the relic taught you. ?
sections.Completion:
Well done, . Applying the rune you have learned to your equipment will grant you powerful new abilities.

Seek out more of our lost relics along your travels.
sections.Notes: The Lunar Idol can be found in the Bristleback Loot Cache in Brambleblade Ravine. Equip it and get six killing blows on mobs affected by Moonfire, after which the idol can be used to learn the rune.

Speak with me again when you are ready. Once at Bloodhoof Village, you can then deliver the leather goods to Varg Windwhisper.

One of the first lessons you should learn, , is to never underestimate your prey.

While we were distracted by the attack on Camp Narache, more of the Bristleback swept in unnoticed and stole a cache of our rifles. You can see them to the south now, filling the air with lead.

This is your Rite of Courage: brave the hail of gunfire, hunt the Bristleback gun thieves, and bring back our rifles.

Chief Squealer Thornmantle leads these quilboar. It was he that set upon Greatmother Hawkwind and took her life, leading the attack on Camp Narache. He fled and hid afterwards, but we've found him. He lurks to the west within his foul den of thorns, fending off any braves we send in after him.

You've proven yourself as a brave defender of our people, . Kill Thornmantle and bring his mane back to Chief Hawkwind, in honor of our Greatmother!

sections.Description:
Behold, . The very presence of the Bristleboar is a blight. Nothing is left in their wake but corpses and barren land. Camp Narache could become what we see here in but a few days, unless we stand and fight.

This will be your Rite of Strength; the first ceremony of a tauren brave. Go into the heart of the thornsnarl and kill Bristleback quilboar, then return to me.

sections.Description:
The Rites of the Earthmother are the steps a young tauren needs to take to gain respect in Thunder Bluff.

First you must pass the Rite of Strength. In this test you must prove your bravery by slaying enemies of the tribe.

Bristlebacks of Brambleblade Ravine to the east are encroaching on our tribal lands. They ambush our hunting parties and steal from the village by dark.

Show your valor by slaying these villains and return to the Chief in Camp Narache with their belts as proof of your deeds.
sections.Objectives:
Kill Bristlebacks in Brambleblade Ravine and bring 12 Bristleback Belts to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache.
- Bristleback Belt (12)

sections.Progress: Have you completed the Rite of Strength, ? I require proof of your valor against the enemy of our tribe, the Bristlebacks.
sections.Completion: You have passed the first test of the Rites of the Earthmother. The tribe will be proud.

title: Rite of Vision

sections.Description:
The Rite of Vision, one of the Rites of the Earthmother, will help guide you toward earning the respect of the elders of Thunder Bluff.

Our people have learned that the land is our most holy provider. In order to take part in the ritualistic vision, you must speak with the spiritual leader of the village, Zarlman Two-Moons.
sections.Objectives: Speak with Zarlman Two-Moons in Bloodhoof Village.
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 55 XP
- +25 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Completion: I sensed you would be coming to me, . I can always recognize one who is trying to pass the Rites of the Earthmother.

sections.Description:
In order to pass through the Rite of Vision, you must gather the reagents needed to make the Water of the Seers.

I will need well stones, which can be found around the water wells in Mulgore. With those I will combine Ambercorn, which fall beneath the mighty trees in our land.

These reagents contain magical elements, and when brewed and consumed before the tribal fire, will cause you to encounter a vision. Follow it, and it will lead you to the next step of this holy quest.
sections.Objectives:
Collect 2 Well Stones and 2 Ambercorn and bring them back to Zarlman Two-Moons in Bloodhoof Village.
- Well Stone (2)
- Ambercorn (2)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 625 XP
- +250 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress: Once you have gathered enough well stones from around the water wells and Ambercorn from beneath the trees, I will prepare the Water of the Seers for you.
sections.Completion: I see you have learned to gather from our sacred land, . It will take but a moment for me to brew the Water of the Seers.
sections.Notes and trivia:
- Southeast of Bloodhoof Village is water well. You should be able to find the Well Stones on the ground around the well. The well is guarded by employees of the Venture Company.
- Ambercorns can be found under the trees in Mulgore. They look like large acorns.
- During the original alpha, this quest required 4 Windblossoms and 4 Earthbloom. They were found in the same locations as the later Well Stones and Ambercorn respectively.

sections.Description:
I now present you with the Water of the Seers.

When you are ready, consume the waters near the tribal fire. Once you have ingested the holy waters, it will take a few moments before the vision materializes before the fire.

At that point, it is up to you to follow it to your destiny....
sections.Objectives:
Consume the Water of the Seers in front of the tribal fire in Bloodhoof Village and follow the vision once it appears.
- Water of the Seers (provided)
sections.Rewards:
- 480 XP
- +150 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Completion: Be not afraid, . You have successfully passed the Rite of Vision.
sections.Notes:
- The tribal fire is to the north of Zarlman. It looks like a large bonfire. Use the Water of the Seers (right-click it) and you should see a ghost wolf appear. Follow the wolf to Seer Wiserunner.
- The wolf moves rather slow, so many people don't follow the wolf but run ahead to the Seer. You can start the next quest in the series before the wolf reaches the Seer.
- Seer Wiserunner can be located northwest from Bloodhoof Village in a cave in the mountains (coordinates 33,36).
- For some people, the ghost wolf doesn't appear or doesn't move. If that occurs, just run ahead to the Seer.

sections.Description:
I cannot thank you enough for cleansing my tribe's well, , and for fighting the savage Grimtotem to do it. But there is more to be done, and it is time for your journey to lead you beyond Bloodhoof Village.

Zarlman Two-Moons stands by the fire in the north end of the village. Go speak with him and learn of the next ritual you must undertake.
sections.Objectives: Speak with Zarlman Two-Moons in Bloodhoof Village.
sections.Completion: I sensed you would be coming to me, . I can always recognize one who is trying to pass the Rites of the Earthmother.

info.name: Rite of Vision
info.rewards: Earthmother's Vest or Rainwalker's Bracer or Earthmother's Garb

sections.Description:
Again, be sure you are ready to leave Bloodhoof Village behind, . The next step on your journey will take you far from here.

Your path continues to lead onward, across the fields of Mulgore, the eyes of the Earth Mother on you at all times. When you are ready, consume the waters near the tribal fire. Once you have ingested the holy waters, your eyes will be opened, and the spirits will guide you.
sections.Objectives:

- Water of Vision (provided)
sections.Rewards:

- +150 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Completion: Be not afraid, . You have successfully passed the Rite of Vision.
sections.Notes: Completing the quest will transport you to Camp Sungraze, in northern Mulgore, where more quests are available.

To gain acceptance amongst the elders of Thunder Bluff you must next complete the Rite of Wisdom.

Now that you have passed the Rite of Vision, the ancestral spirits of Red Rocks will give you the blessing of our ancestors. Only those who have drunk from the Water of Seers can gain the blessing.

Travel east of Thunder Bluff, to Red Rocks and seek out the Ancestral Spirit, .

We, the Ancestral Spirits, represent the mighty tauren who gave their lives bravely to found and protect our great city of Thunder Bluff. I hereby pass the duty of that protection over to you.

sections.Description:
Look, . The rolling plains of Mulgore stretch before you: our home, the cradle of the Earth Mother. Here she provides us with all we could ever need, a peaceful and verdant land. This is what you will fight to protect.

Your journey will take you far beyond her sheltering arms, to the farthest and cruelest regions of this world, and beyond.

Below us is Bloodhoof Village. The first step on your true path begins now. Drink deep of the Water of Vision, and let the spirits guide you onward.
sections.Objectives:
Drink the Water of Vision.
- Water of Vision (provided)
sections.Completion: Welcome to Bloodhoof Village, hero. I am glad the spirits have guided you safely here.
sections.Notes: Drinking the Water of Vision next to the quest giver transports you to Bloodhoof Village. New quests await!

sections.Description:
Your willingness to perform a humble task for the tauren of Narache and your eagerness to learn are noble traits, . I believe one day you will be heralded in Thunder Bluff as a of greatness.

Before that you must embark on the Rites of the Earthmother, of which there are three.

The first test is the Rite of Strength. Travel to Seer Graytongue and tell him Chief Hawkwind has sent you.

You will find the seer's abode directly to the south of Camp Narache, tucked away in the hills.
sections.Objectives: Travel to Seer Graytongue who lives in the hills directly south of Camp Narache.
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 250 XP (or at max level)
- +250 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Completion: Chief Hawkwind sent you? Embarking on the Rites of the Earthmother is no small task...
sections.Notes: Upon completion, Seer Graytongue buffs the player with the Mark of the Wild.

sections.Description:
For you to continue with the Rites of the Earthmother you must pass two more tests. It is time for you to broaden your experience, .

Travel to Bloodhoof Village and seek out the Chief, Baine Bloodhoof, son of Cairne. There you may continue your journey and earn the acceptance of the elders of Thunder Bluff.

Take this totem to Baine. He will recognize my carvings and help you on your path.

Follow the road out of Camp Narache and travel with haste. Do not stray or you will lose your way.
sections.Objectives:
Take the Totem of Hawkwind to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village. Follow the road out of Camp Narache.
- Totem of Hawkwind (provided)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 340 XP (or at max level)
- +150 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress: What brings you to my village, ?
sections.Completion: Word from my good friend, Chief Hawkwind! Ah, I can see by his carvings you are of a special breed.

sections.Description:
Today, you have undertaken a rite of passage far more difficult than we ask of most of our youths. Be proud. Now, it is time for you to continue on your journey.

To the west, beyond our burial ground, you will find a path winding up the mesa. Follow it to the top, and speak with Dyami Windsoar.

Walk with the Earth Mother, friend. You will always be welcome here.
sections.Objectives: Speak to Dyami Windsoar atop Fargaze Mesa.
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 150 XP
- +150 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Completion: If you are prepared to leave Camp Narache behind, I will help call the spirits to guide you onwards.

sections.Progress:
, in my quest to become the strongest woman alive, I have traveled the world and learned muscle building secrets from distant weight masters, strength gurus, and ancient manuals. I now know forbidden exercises that would kill the weak and cripple the uninitiated!

These feats of strength and conditioning require training with the densest of grinding stones. , can you find or make some grinding stones and bring them to me? I'll give you tickets if you do... 
- Dense Grinding Stone (8)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 20x Darkmoon Faire Prize Ticket
- +250 reputation with
sections.Completion:
Thank you, . I will use these stones in a strength-gaining ritual I learned from an ancient tablet in the deepest jungles of Stranglethorn.

It is said that she who performs this sacred rite correctly will have the strength and endurance of ten Tauren!
sections.Notes: See Darkmoon Faire Reputation for details of this quest's availability.

sections.Description: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, . I believe she was sent by the shaman trainer Meela. If this note is from Meela, I wouldn't take long in reading its contents.
sections.Objectives:
Read the Rune-Inscribed Note and speak to Meela Dawnstrider in Camp Narache.
- Rune-Inscribed Note (provided)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 130 XP
-
sections.Progress: As quickly as water falls from the sky, here you are before me. I am pleased by your haste. It means you realize both the importance of our meeting and you being here. I am no leader, but I do understand the elements, and I can speak to the spirits of our people. I will teach you to do the same.
sections.Completion:
We will meet many times in the days to come. Each time you will hopefully leave my company a little more powerful... a little more prepared. Like the Eternal Flame, your spirit will burn bright and hot.

Go now, . Go and test yourself. I will be here for you when you need.

sections.Description:
, there are many conflicts that wound this land. It is my hope that you will not bear witness to as many of them as our elders have. Yet there is one that I would ask you to seek. It will give you some sense of how terrible, if left unchecked, even a small threat can be to the land.

Palemane gnolls have settled to the south of Bloodhoof and in a cave to the west. They disrespect our attempts to communicate with them, and they slay the wildlife of Mulgore unbridled.

Words are no longer the answer.
sections.Objectives:
Kill 15 Palemane Gnolls then return to Ahmo Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village.
- Palemane Gnoll slain (15)
sections.Progress: If the Palemanes had respected the land and its inhabitants more, this conflict would have never occurred.
sections.Completion: , it is good you've taken the task seriously. Respect of the land and its creatures is important. Death and life are a circle... a necessity. One cannot exist without the other. Take time to ponder this and do well to never forget it.

sections.Description: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, . I believe she was sent by the warrior trainer Harutt. If this note is from Harutt, I wouldn't take long in reading it's contents.
sections.Objectives:
Read the Simple Note and speak to Harutt Thunderhorn in Camp Narache.
- Simple Note (provided)
sections.Progress: Ah, at last, you've arrived, warrior. I did not lie in my note, . We are a special breed also, not unlike the druids or shamans of our tribe. You are just as important. We are the ones called upon to defend our borders, to hunt the centaur, and to go to war.
sections.Completion:
Each of us plays a role in our tribe. Each of us must also go through all the same rites. Do not ever let your pride tell you otherwise.

I remain here to train new warriors that seek the glory of battle and who follow the ways of our oldest ancestors. When you feel ready, come back to me and I will do what I can to train you further. Go with the tribe's blessing, .

sections.Progress:
The first lesson in drawing a crowd is: lure them with gadgets and trinkets! Can you help me?

I need small furry paws to use for prizes. You can find those on the cats of the Barrens or Darkshore....

Bring me some paws and I'll trade you a Darkmoon Faire ticket for them.
- Small Furry Paw (5)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 1x Darkmoon Faire Prize Ticket
- +250 reputation with
sections.Completion:
Great, you got them! We can use these to make toys and baubles, and those will attract more people to the Faire!

Here's your ticket, . You earned it!
sections.Notes: See Darkmoon Faire Reputation for details of this quest's availability.

sections.Progress:
It's amazing what people value! Take, for instance, a wooden stick with a soft bushy tail attached to it. Now, you and I might think something like that isn't all that valuable... but if you give that piece of junk a neat name like "Savage Fuzz Tail" and put it in a
pretty box, then people will think it's valuable. Trash becomes treasure!

Get me soft bushy tails from the wolves of Desolace and the Badlands, and I'll give you Darkmoon Faire tickets. 
- Soft Bushy Tail (5)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 8x Darkmoon Faire Prize Ticket
- +250 reputation with
sections.Completion:
Well done, ! These tails will make great prizes for our visitors, and that means happy visitors... who talk to their friends and bring more visitors!

Here are your tickets! Have a good time at the Darkmoon Faire... and don't forget to tell your friends about us!
sections.Notes: See Darkmoon Faire Reputation for details of this quest's availability.

sections.Description:
The ancestors have whispered your name, . Now it is time for you to reach out to them.

Here in this sacred place, we spiritwalkers commune with those who came before us. Sit within the circle and light the incense.

If you open your heart, a spirit guide will present itself to you. Let us hope it will lead you to the answers we seek.
sections.Objectives:
Light the Spiritwalker's Incense at Fargaze Mesa in Camp Narache.
- Light Spiritwalker's Incense
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- - 17,850 XP
sections.Completion: What did you see?
sections.Notes:

- Chieftain Iti

sections.Description:
Knowing the ways of your prey is another aspect of the hunt. In the lands they come from, quilboar live in the shade and protection of huge thorned roots. When they move, their shamans seed and grow new roots for them to live in.

These thorns mar the land and choke out other life, turning the earth around them barren. Go to the south and stop these thorncallers before they have a chance to continue, .
sections.Objectives:
Kill 7 Bristleback Thorncallers.
- Bristleback Thorncaller slain (7)
sections.Rewards:
You will also receive:
- - 200 XP
- +250 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress: The roots still thrive. You must stop as many of the thorncallers as you can.
sections.Completion: With the corruptors slain, the Earth Mother will mend her own wounds in due time. The roots are not meant to thrive here, and will wither. Balance will return.

info.name: Supervisor Fizsprocket
info.rewards: Compact Fighting Knife or Goblin Smasher

sections.Description:
According to the documents you salvaged from the caravan, the Venture Co created many plans to attempt to drive us from our lands here so that they could have free reign to plunder our lands.

The depths that they would sink to accomplish their goals disgusts and appalls me.
sections.Objectives: Go to the mine and kill Supervisor Fizsprocket and return his clipboard to Morin Cloudstalker as proof.
sections.Progress: I seethe with anger at the thought of the atrocities the Venture Co. is willing to perpetrate against us in the name of profit.
sections.Rewards:
You will also receive:
- 910 XP
- +100 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Completion: My anger is somewhat lessened at the news that the villain Fizsprocket is dead. I will go through his personal effects and see if there is any additional information about what the Venture Co. has planned for the future. Thank you for your efforts, .
sections.Notes:
As you enter the mine directly to the east of the Ravaged Caravan the mine will split into three tunnels. You will choose the tunnel all the way on the right and continue heading to the right. In a small room with about 6 Venture Co Workers and 4 Venture Co Supervisors, Supervisor Fizsprocket will be standing along the wall.
- If you work along the wall, you end up being able to sneak by and slowly take out only one side of the mine's enemies instead of walking down the center.

sections.Description:
The swoop is a cunning bird, and difficult to find and hunt. A collection of Swoop Quills is a badge of cleverness and determination for a hunter.

If you are willing to take up this task, then enter the plains and hunt the swoop.

Bring me their quills, and bring honor to your clan.

The swoops may be found anywhere in Mulgore, but your eyes must be sharp to spot them, and your hooves must be quick to catch them.
sections.Objectives:
Bring 8 Trophy Swoop Quills to Harken Windtotem in Bloodhoof Village.
- Trophy Swoop Quill (8)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- - 675 XP
- +350 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress: Have you found the swoops, . Do you have their quills?
sections.Completion: I know that gathering these quills was not an easy task, . In doing this, you prove that you are a of merit. It is good to have you at Bloodhoof Village.

sections.Description:
As a tauren, it is important to follow the traditions of our ancestors by fighting mighty creatures. By besting these creatures, we are able to intake their spirits, allowing us to become closer to the Earthmother.

In the same way, taming a beast to fight alongside us helps us become one with nature around us. Eventually, you will learn to tame a beast of your choosing. But all things take practice, and you have much to learn. Begin by taking this taming rod; you must tame an adult plainstrider.
sections.Objectives:
Use the Taming Rod to tame an Adult Plainstrider. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.
- Taming Rod (provided)
- Tame an Adult Plainstrider
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 850 XP
sections.Progress: Practice your skills, . Tame the adult plainstrider.
sections.Completion: Signs have appeared to me from the Earthmother; you have done well.

sections.Description:
You have a fiery spirit, hunter, readily awaiting your next challenge.

Your next task is to gain the companionship of a wolf known as the prairie stalker. This creature is swift and fearless; in taking this beast as your pet, you must also take on these qualities.

During a battle, you will learn how you and your pet will become a team. In the end you must work as one, muscle to muscle.

Here is the taming rod, . Tame a prairie stalker and practice your skills.
sections.Objectives:
Use the Taming Rod to tame a Prairie Stalker. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.
- Taming Rod (provided)
- Tame a Prairie Stalker
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 850 XP
sections.Progress: Have you found a prairie stalker?
sections.Completion: Yes... The Earthmother believes that you are ready for the next lesson.

- Taming the Beast (Tauren 2)
- Taming the Beast (Tauren 3)

sections.Description:
The final task that I have for you requires that you tame a creature that inhabits the sky. The swoop is a difficult opponent, but as your ally, you will acquire its sharp attacks and threatening presence.

By the will of the Earthmother, when you return I will bestow you with the skills you will need to tame an animal of your choosing to be your companion; this creature will face the challenges you face, and gain experience alongside you. I will also show you how to call it and dismiss it as you wish.
sections.Objectives:
Use the Taming Rod to tame a Swoop. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.
- Taming Rod (provided)
- Tame a Swoop
sections.Rewards:
Taming Lesson
- Ability: Tame Beast
- Ability: Call Pet
- Ability: Dismiss Pet

You will also receive:
- 850 XP
sections.Progress: You will soon be ready, .
sections.Completion:
You have learned all I can teach you, . May the blessings of the Earthmother guide you in choosing a pet.

Here you are, . I will now give you the power to tame a beast, as well as call it and dismiss it as you see fit. Use your new skills with pride and honor the Earthmother.
