sections.Description:
The tauren starting experience takes place on Red Cloud Mesa, in southern Mulgore. Players are immediately thrust into battle against the quilboar who are mere days away from taking Camp Narache. Working with Grull Hawkwind and Adana Thunderhorn, players slay quilboar, rescue tauren captives, return stolen weapons and prevent the quilboar from using a special weapon, the battleboars, among other things. On the way, players complete their Rite of Strength by slaying quilboar, their Rite of Courage by recovering stolen rifles, and their Rite of Honor by slaying Chief Squealer Thornmantle. The Red Cloud Mesa ends with the quest Rite of the Winds which transports players to Bloodhoof Village.

 
Category:Quest chains
Category:Zone storylines

Wait, . I have another ask of you, before you leave us.

There is an adventurer by the name of Kaga Wildhoof who has made camp just outside of Bloodhoof Village. She has greatly helped me in the past, and now I see my chance to repay her. Could you deliver these supplies to her?
sections.Objectives:
Deliver the Supply Bundle to Kaga Wildhoof near Bloodhoof Village.
- Supply Bundle (provided)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 410 XP

sections.Description:
The Battleboars of Brambleblade Ravine to the east are encroaching on our tribal hunting grounds. They are trained to be malicious by the Bristleback Quilboars with whom we are at war.

Go and slay the vile creatures and bring back some snouts and flanks so that we can make stew for our young.
sections.Objectives:
Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache wants you to kill Battleboars and bring back 8 Battleboar Snouts and 8 Battleboar Flanks.
- Battleboar Snout (8)
- Battleboar Flank (8)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:

You will also receive:
- 450 XP (or at max level)
- +350 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress: The aggression of the Battleboars is increasing. Have you sent them a clear message and brought back some snouts and flanks yet?
sections.Completion: Most excellent. These ingredients will make a fine stew and the loss of those boars should be a fair lesson to those vile Bristlebacks.

info.name: The Battleboars
info.rewards: Scarred Battleboar Chest or Braided Boarskin Belt or Scarred Battleboar Breastplate

sections.Description:
There are more threats to be dealt with here. The Bristleback are taming wild boars to be used against us.

These armored battleboars have been abused beyond hope of recovery; they must be put down, for our safety and their peace. Go to the pens to the south and slay them, . Return to me afterwards.
sections.Objectives:
Kill 10 Armored Battleboars.
- Armored Battleboar slain (10)
sections.Rewards:
You will also receive:
- - 200 XP
- +250 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress: I can still see many of them from here, . More should fall.
sections.Completion: Good work, . Those beasts could have been a greater threat than the quilboar themselves, if we had not taken action now.
sections.Notes:
This quest should be done at the same time as Feed of Evil.

Burning the troughs for the quest Feed of Evil usually kills several boars, effectively reducing the amount of boars you'll need to kill.

sections.Description:
The ragged hide of Ghost Howl still bears a terrible wound, gained from the wolf's battles against the Burning Legion.

Perhaps someone in Camp Sungraze should know of Ghost Howl's demise....
sections.Objectives:
Find someone who knows of Ghost Howl. 
- Demon Scarred Cloak
sections.Rewards:
You will be able to choose one of these rewards:
- Skorn's Hammer
- Skorn's Rifle
sections.Completion:
I can barely believe my old eyes! You defeated the great wolf Ghost Howl? I look upon you with new respect, young <class>. You are a hunter of extreme skills!

Let me offer you something. My days of hunting are over, but I would be honored if you used one of my weapons in your hunts.

May it strike true, and bring you renown.

And let us hope that Ghost Howl's spirit has finally found peace.

sections.Description:
What you see here is the work of the quilboar, young one. Year after year they have encroached on our village. The great cataclysm finally drove them from their dens to spread like locusts across the land, and now you see the result; my own mother, dead from their savagery.

Today, you are of age. Today, you will take up your weapon and fight for the tribe, and avenge the Greatmother. Follow the path to the east, and find my son, Grull. He will lead you in our strike against the quilboar.
sections.Objectives: Follow the path East out of Camp Narache and find Grull Hawkwind.
sections.Rewards: You will receive:
sections.Completion: Welcome to your first true test as a tauren.

sections.Description:
Greetings, . I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.

Elwynn Forest
Well howdy there, . I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

It's a big wide world out there and you'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful. Not sure how your outdoorsman skills are but I reckon I could teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire, get comfy. I'll walk you through it.
sections.Objectives:
Sit near 's Basic Campfire by typing /sit in the chat window and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
- Use the /sit emote near the campfire
- Gain the Boosted Rest buff
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 410 XP
sections.Progress: Having the skills needed to survive the outdoors are critical. A well-rested and well-prepared adventurer has a much higher chance of surviving this lifestyle.
sections.Completion: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.

sections.Description:
You have a promising air about you, and will prove yourself to the tribe. Perhaps someday soon you will be welcomed into the great city of Thunder Bluff. But before that can happen you must prove yourself to my father, Chief Hawkwind.

Up here on Red Cloud Mesa we pride ourselves on keen hunting skills. Tauren hunt out of necessity and for sport. Our supply of meats has run low and we require feathers for clothing. Hunt the nearby plainstriders and prove yourself by resupplying the village.
sections.Objectives:
Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache wants you to bring him 7 Plainstrider Feathers and 7 pieces of Plainstrider Meat.
- Plainstrider Meat (7)
- Plainstrider Feather (7)
sections.Rewards:
You will be able to choose one of these rewards:
- Nomadic Belt
- Painted Chain Gloves

You will also receive:
- 170 XP (or at max level)
- +250 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress: Providing meat and feathers for the tribe is the first step in proving yourself as a hunter before the Chief.
sections.Completion: The of Narache thank you, . You show much promise.

sections.Description:
A tauren skilled in the ways of the hunt knows that his prey is not for mere trophy. The beasts of the plains provide us with a means of survival. You will make quite an impression on the elders if you can bring back some highly valued Mountain Cougar Pelts. You can find the beasts lurking in the hills to the south.

Our children need clothing and our tents need mending.
sections.Objectives:
Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache wants you to bring him 10 Mountain Cougar Pelts.
- Mountain Cougar Pelt (10)
sections.Progress: If you can provide pelts for the tribe I will pass word along to my father, Chief Hawkwind, of your generous deeds.
sections.Completion: The of Narache thank you for these provisions, . With your skill in the ways of the hunt you will surely be revered in Thunder Bluff someday.
sections.Rewards:
You will also gain:
- 250 XP (or at max level)
- 250 with Thunder Bluff

sections.Description:
Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion. 

You must see Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.
sections.Objectives: Speak with Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.
sections.Rewards: - 85 XP
sections.Completion: Yes, it is time for you to begin your training.
sections.Progression:
- The Hunter's Path (Tauren)
- Taming the Beast (Tauren 1)
- Taming the Beast (Tauren 2)
- Taming the Beast (Tauren 3)
- Training the Beast (Tauren)

sections.Description:
You are eager to explore, I can tell. I too had the lust to wander, once...

Wander, and hunt. For hunting is a tauren's greatest honor.

If you truly wish to follow the ways of the hunter, show me your skill and resolve. Bring me the claws of the flatland prowlers of Mulgore. They are tough and cunning -- fitting prey for a young on the path of the hunt.
sections.Objectives:

sections.Description:
You are eager to explore, I can tell. I too had the lust to wander, once...

Wander, and hunt. For hunting is a Tauren's greatest honor.

If you truly wish to follow the ways of the hunter, then Melor Stonehoof can show you the path. He is in Thunder Bluff, on the Hunter's Rise.

And to show him your skill and resolve, bring him the claws of the flatland prowlers of Mulgore. They are tough and cunning -- fitting prey for a young on the hunter's path.
sections.Objectives:
Bring 4 Flatland Prowler Claws to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
- Flatland Prowler Claw (4)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 850 XP (or at max level)
- +250 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress: Greetings. There is an air about you that tells me much. Do we have business, you and I?
sections.Completion:
Skorn Whitecloud is a wise tauren. He has hunted for years and years, and although his body is old, his spirit burns fiercely. We are honored to have him with us.

If Skorn sent you to me, then you too must have the hunter's spirit. And to have gathered these claws shows your burgeoning skills.

Perhaps you are ready to walk the path.

sections.Description:
A few days ago, we found a Venture Co. caravan traveling under guard on the northern shore of Stonebull Lake. We'd lost two of our number in an earlier battle, so we were quick to attack and lay waste to the caravan.

We left their supply crates, thinking that our torches would destroy anything of value, but given that Venture Co. salvagers have been spotted near the burned wagons, maybe we were wrong.

Perhaps you could go to the caravan and examine the contents of the crates.
sections.Objectives: Morin Cloudstalker wants you to examine the contents of a supply crate at the Ravaged Caravan.
sections.Completion: All sides of the crate are stamped with the sign of the Venture Co. Mining Division. Notes printed carefully on the side of the carton indicate that the contents are due for processing at one of their central plants.

sections.Description:
Prying open the lid reveals a tightly packed assortment of ore and minerals, more evidence of the Venture Co.'s mining operation in Mulgore. On the top of the ore and minerals you remove a tightly bound sheaf of papers.

Up in the foothills to the east, you can barely hear the sounds of work, and see smoke rising from a large fire.
sections.Objectives:
Return the Venture Co. Documents to Morin Cloudstalker near Bloodhoof Village.
- Venture Co. Documents (Provided)
sections.Progress:
Hail, . Have you learned anything new about the Venture Co.'s plans and operations in our homeland?

If they plan to exploit our lands as they have others, the Outrunners will be quick to put an end to it.
sections.Completion: It does indeed appear that the Venture Co. is attempting to rob us of our natural resources. It is good to know this for true, and now it seems, we must do something about it.

info.name: The Restless Earth
info.rewards: Chestguard of the Beating Drum or Restless Gloves or Worn Ceremonial Tomahawk

sections.Description:
Until recently, a group of dwarves intruded on our lands to the west, carving the earth apart senselessly to search for treasure. When the very earth itself tore apart, the spirits of the land they had abused rose up and took their revenge.

The agitated earth spirits still roam the former dig site, . We must offer them appeasement.

Take this drum with you to the west and play to the spirits. The rhythm may calm their fury and confusion.
sections.Objectives:
Use the Drums of the Soothed Earth to calm 6 Agitated Earth Spirits.
- Spirits Calmed (6)
- Drum of the Soothed Earth (provided)
sections.Rewards: You will also receive:
sections.Progress: Is the land satisfied?
sections.Completion:
The land is clearly still in great upheaval if it took such effort to calm.

Remember this, . Do not forget seeing the fate of those who would scar the Earth Mother.
sections.Notes: Unsuccessful attempt

sections.Description:
This explains the buildup of Venture Co. employees and equipment we've seen in Mulgore. Those goblins... their company is expanding too quickly for their own good. It's how they say, show a goblin something, and you can hear the scales in the background.

Greedy little things, they are. Unfortunately for their business enterprise, we tauren cannot allow them to conduct their operations in our lands. Go to their mine northeast of the ravaged caravan and send them a message.
sections.Objectives:
Kill 7 Venture Co. Workers for Morin Cloudstalker at Bloodhoof Village.
- Venture Co. Worker slain (7)
sections.Rewards: You will receive:
sections.Progress: The Venture Co. was refused mining rights here in Mulgore, but it would seem that they do not take no for an answer. We tauren are not ones to mince words, however, and we have other ways of getting our message across.
sections.Completion: I don't think there could be too much misinterpreting or ignoring of that signal, hm? The Venture Co. will know not to take the tauren lightly, or to be so arrogant as to believe we would allow them to steal the natural resources around us without protest.

There are two locations in Mulgore that have the Venture Co. Supervisors and Venture Co Workers that you need to kill to complete this quest. The one mentioned in the description is The Venture Co. Mine, more due east than northeast of The Ravaged Caravan. This is the preferred location as there are plenty of both types of NPCs to kill, and you can combine this with the Supervisor Fizsprocket (Classic) quest in the same mine to save time.

The second location is a small Venture Co. camp north-northeast of the north (2nd tier) elevators in Thunder Bluff. This location has the disadvantages that there are fewer NPCs, only two supervisors, and you will still have to enter the mine to do the Supervisor Fizsprocket (Classic) quest.

sections.Progress:
Yebb Nebblegear is looking to add more talent to his show, and he's searching far and wide for the world's largest gnome. Do you know any gnomes of considerable size?

Well before he finds the gnome, he wants to have its costume ready. I think a barbaric harness would be a good foundation for the costume; can you make some harnesses and bring them to me? Do that, and I'll have a stack of Darkmoon Faire tickets for you...
- Barbaric Harness (3)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- +250 reputation with the 
- 8x Darkmoon Faire Prize Ticket
sections.Completion:
Oh dear, these are quite large!! I can't imagine finding a gnome that would fit snugly into them, but not to worry - if the gnome we find is not big enough, I can make adjustments to his costume.

Many thanks, . Here are the tickets I promised you.

sections.Progress:
Yebb Neblegear, like me, is working on a future attraction. So amazing is this attraction, says Nebb, that it will draw folks from across the world... and it will make us all very, very rich!

He says he needs thorium widgets for its construction, and wants me to collect them for him. So what do you say, ? Do you know where to get Thorium widgets? If you're an engineer, can you make them? Do you want to trade them for Darkmoon Faire tickets? 
- Thorium Widget (6)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 20x Darkmoon Faire Prize Ticket
- +250 reputation with
sections.Completion:
Ah, thank you, ! Yebb will enjoy these widgets. I don't know what he has planned for them, but Yebb's a clever little gnome. He's clever, and maybe a little devious....

If only he liked the taste of humanoid flesh... he'd make a great troll!

Here, . A deal's a deal, and these tickets are yours.

info.rewards: Bloodhoof War Shield or Thunderhorn Gloves or Touch of Dawn or Thunderhorn Handguards

sections.Description:
The Grimtotem are a tribe that believe all of Kalimdor should belong to the Tauren alone. Their hate and anger led to a corrupting thirst for power. Magatha, their leader, poisoned our High Chieftain, Cairne Bloodhoof, and attempted to take Thunder Bluff for herself; she was defeated, and the Grimtotem exiled.

Now they seek to ruin Mulgore itself as they are driven out. Quickly, , you must go to the Thunderhorn Water Well in the north and perform the ritual!
sections.Objectives:
Use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem at the Thunderhorn Water Well.
- Well Cleansed
- Return to Mull Thunderhorn at Bloodhoof Village.
- Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem (provided)
sections.Rewards:
You will also receive:
- 200 XP
- +250 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress: Do not fear the Grimtotem, . They are vicious, but we must fight to protect our homeland.
sections.Completion: You've done great honor for both me and my ancestors today. Please, take this with my gratitude.
sections.Notes: Upon accept

sections.Description:
The totem is ready, . And again, it is your task to perform the ritual of cleansing.

Go to the Thunderhorn Water Well, north of the village, and use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem in your ritual. After you do this, return to me.

May the spirits guide you.
sections.Objectives:
Use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem at the Thunderhorn Water Well, then return to Mull.
- Cleanse the Thunderhorn Water Well
- Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem (provided)
sections.Rewards:
You will also gain:
- 700 XP
- +250 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Completion:
Ancestors of the Thunderhorn clan spoke to me in a dream, praising you for your actions near their well.

For their gratitude, they wish to give you this...

sections.Description:
There is more work to be done. We must create a new totem to cleanse the Thunderhorn Well.

You must gather the claws of the predators of the Mulgore plains. Hunt prairie stalkers for their stalker claws and flatland cougars for their cougar claws, then return to me.

You will find the prairie stalkers and flatland cougars to the east and west.
sections.Objectives:
Collect 6 Stalker Claws and 6 Cougar Claws.
- Stalker Claws (6)
- Cougar Claws (6)
sections.Progress: , do you have the claws I sent you to gather? The Thunderhorn Water Well grows more tainted with each passing hour!
sections.Completion:
Thank you, . The purity with which these beasts hunt is vital in the creation of the next cleansing totem.

The Thunderhorn Well is a symbol of my own tribe, and to know it is being desecrated by our own kind raises a fury in me I haven't felt for years.
sections.Notes:

sections.Description:
You have done well. As you continue along your path, you will grow, learning new techniques that you couldn't have imagined before.

Your first lesson is the power of experience. Go, learn a new ability, and demonstrate it for me.
sections.Objectives:
Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm. Locate a Training Dummy in Camp Narache and practice using it.
- Practice Tiger Palm: 0/1
sections.Progress: Have you mastered a new technique?
sections.Completion: You have done well, .

sections.Progress:
Children love toys! And no matter what race, I've found that all children love furry, plushy toys made from torn bear pelts!

You can get those pelts from the bears of Ashenvale or Hillsbrad. Bring me a heap of them and earn yourself a heap of Darkmoon Faire tickets! 
- Torn Bear Pelt (5)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 4x Darkmoon Faire Prize Ticket
- +250 reputation with (until you have 1100 reputation)
sections.Completion:
Nice pelts, ! I'll get someone to sew these into a bunch of plush toys. With a little stuffing and some paint, I think they'll be the envy of children across Azeroth!

Tickets? Ah yes, your payment! Here they are!
sections.Notes: See Darkmoon Faire Reputation for details of this quest's availability.

sections.Description:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it.

Travel to Thunder Bluff. There you must speak to one of our most revered hunters, Holt Thunderhorn. If he deems you worthy, he will give you the ability to train your new pet.

Holt has bested the most powerful and feared beasts of Azeroth, and commands many strong creatures of his own. His ties to the Earthmother are strong, and you can learn much from him. Good luck, .
sections.Objectives: Speak with Holt Thunderhorn on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff.
sections.Rewards:
Training Lesson
- Ability: Beast Training
- Ability: Feed Pet
- Ability: Revive Pet

You will also receive:
- 420 XP
sections.Completion:
A young hunter, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.

Now, go forth. May the Earthmother guide you on your path. We shall speak again, at a later date.
sections.Progression:
- The Hunter's Path (Tauren)
- Taming the Beast (Tauren 1)
- Taming the Beast (Tauren 2)
- Taming the Beast (Tauren 3)
- Training the Beast (Tauren)

sections.Description: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, . I believe she was sent by the druid trainer Gart. If this note is from Gart, I wouldn't take long in reading its contents.
sections.Objectives:
Read the Verdant Note and speak to Gart Mistrunner in Camp Narache.
- Verdant Note (provided)
sections.Progress: You have arrived. This is good. Our ancestors' sprits have become restless throughout Mulgore and beyond, but I cannot tell why. It will forever by your duty to learn to listen to nature's spirits, and act as their avatar. Be mindful of that.
sections.Completion:
Though we share a common bond, do not expect much welcome from the night elves. Their pride still limits their sight, but that is none of our concern. The teachings of the Earthmother are all you must concern yourself with, and I will teach you what I know as you grow in wisdom.

Return to me often, . You will find that the Earthmother grants incredible abilities to those who are most dedicated.

sections.Description:
The Horde honors its warriors because their strength is unquestioned. But the truly great warriors are great students as well.

Seek out Uzzek. He is a veteran of many battles and now instructs young warriors in the ways of combat. You will find him south of Far Watch Post, the orc garrison on the border of the Barrens and Durotar to the east.
sections.Objectives: Speak with Uzzek at Far Watch Post.
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 90 XP
sections.Completion: Hello, young one. Here for some instruction, are you?
sections.Notes: Uzzek is not standing right at Far Watch Post but a little to the southwest next to a tree.

sections.Progress:
A person's imagination is an incredible thing. It can make the smallest hill seem like the largest mountain. It can make the most innocuous shadow appear cast by a horrible nightmare!

We at the Darkmoon Faire let our visitor's imaginations blossom! But to help stretch their imaginations... sometimes we have to get tricky.

I need vibrant plumes for one of my attractions. You can get them from the birds of the more dangerous areas of Azeroth. Bring me the
plumes and many tickets will be yours!
- Vibrant Plume (5)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 12x Darkmoon Faire Prize Ticket
- +250 reputation with
sections.Completion:
Ah, the plumes! They are amazing, don't you think! It would be easy to spark one's imaginations with such beauties!

You do such charitable work, . The smiles on our visitors' faces when they see the show is a grand payment indeed, but please
take these tickets as well.

info.rewards: Dreamwalking Staff or Kodo Mallet or Stunted Tree Root or Sunwalker's Stunner or Kodo Gavel, and Kodo Saddlebag

sections.Description:
Some see our people as gentle giants, or noble savages. They have never seen us fight against our own kind...against betrayers from within.

The Grimtotem were offered mercy in exile, and they have scarred their own home to spite us. They will no longer be tolerated in Mulgore.

I've already sent our warriors ahead to drive them out through Stonetalon Pass, to the north. You have fought bravely against the Grimtotem, ; I ask that you join the battle again. Go, and help deal this final blow.
sections.Objectives:
Defeat Orno Grimtotem at Stonetalon Pass.
- Orno Grimtotem slain
sections.Rewards:
You will also receive:
- - 200 XP
- Kodo Saddlebag
sections.Progress: I do not plan on sitting idly in Thunder Bluff while our warriors risk their lives for our home, . We shall meet on the battlefield. Strike out ahead of me; I will leave soon.
sections.Completion:
Welcome back, .

What was done was not for revenge, or pride. It was simply to protect Thunder Bluff, and all our people, from torment and fear. Today, Mulgore is safe once more.

The Earth Mother thanks you for all your brave deeds, , as do I. You have earned your reward, hero. May you be welcome in Thunder Bluff always.
sections.Notes:
Stonetalon Pass is northwest of Thunder Bluff, Orno Grimtotem can be found at the top. Shortly after engaging him in combat, Baine arrives.
Two non-elite Grimtotem mobs spawn and starts attacking Baine.
Baine knocks back the non-elite Grimtotems, killing them instantly, also knocking back Orno then finish him shortly after.
Orno dies.

sections.Description:
Welcome to the World of Warcraft!

As special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Vorn Skyseer in Bloodhoof Village. You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.

Thanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!
sections.Objectives:
Bring the Bloodhoof Village Gift Voucher to Vorn Skyseer in Bloodhoof Village.
- Bloodhoof Village Gift Voucher (provided)
sections.Progress:
Greetings! It is a pleasure to meet you!

I see you have a special voucher. Give it to me and I will offer you something in exchange.
sections.Completion: You are indeed a special hero, . We welcome you to the world of Azeroth, and offer you one of these unique gifts!

sections.Progress:
My new booth will be a sight to see, yes sir! A sight to see, and... for a lucky few, to touch!

I can already hear the whirring bronze gizmos singing their song of mechanical rapture as patrons step to my booth and test their skill!

Ah... now I need the gizmos themselves to bring my dream closer to fruition. Please, , bring me whirring bronze gizmos... and Darkmoon Faire tickets will be yours!
- Whirring Bronze Gizmo (7)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- +250 reputation with 
- 4x Darkmoon Faire Prize Ticket
sections.Completion:
You brought the gizmos! Wonderful! Even now I can hear their buzzing, whirring chorus in my mind! Oh, when this booth is ready it will be the wonder of the world, mark me!

Here are your tickets, . And please enjoy your stay at the Faire!
sections.Notes:
You can only do this quest six times (42 Gizmos) or until you reach 1100 reputation with the Darkmoon Faire. When that happens, you'll be directed to the quest Mechanical Repair Kits and to Thorium Widget (quest).

See also Darkmoon Faire quests involving engineered items.

Your cleansing of the Winterhoof and Thunderhorn wells is spoken among the spirits, young . The Wildmane Totem is made, and your last task lies ahead.

The Wildmane Water Well lies north of Thunder Bluff. Perform the ritual! Heal the land of the Grimtotem's poisons! Let clean water flow once again!

You've done it. You have cleaned the wells, and healed our land. Bloodhoof village is grateful, .

May the wind whisper your deeds for a hundred seasons, and may the waters of Mulgore remain clean forever.

This may prove very dangerous, . Be careful...but do not let the defilers of our well escape.

sections.Progress: Do not delay, . The Winterhoof Well must be purified!
sections.Completion:
The Grimtotem...

I'd hoped to see the end of my days before Tauren attacked other Tauren senselessly on the very plains of Mulgore. But be proud, . You have done a great things for the land, and for our people.

This will not be an easy task, but you must do it if we are ever to use its waters again.

Fortune to you, .

You have done a great thing for the land, . And you have done a great thing for the people.

"Your fortune awaits you outside Palemane Rock."

The fortune Sayge handed you feels slightly warm to the touch. Grasping it firmly, you see an image of the Palemane Rock of Mulgore. Focusing closer in on the image, you see a tree stump that sits close to the cave entrance.
sections.Objectives:
Travel to Palemane Rock in Mulgore and seek out your fortune.
- Sayge's Fortune 27 (provided)
sections.Rewards:
You will also receive:
- 650 XP
- +75 reputation with 
- Mysterious Lockbox
sections.Progress: This tree stump looks like the one from your vision.
sections.Completion: A quick search of the tree stump reveals a lockbox from within it! It would seem that you have found your fortune!
sections.Notes: - Does not count towards Loremaster of Kalimdor.

sections.Description:
You know of the Pools of Vision, yes?

There is a sort of mushroom that grows there... not the tough, rank fungi that dominates the place, but smaller, more delicate caps that grow beneath them.

They are rare and quite delicious, adding a flavor to meat dishes that one might even call magical.

...what? No, really. They just taste good. That's it.
sections.Objectives:
Gather 6 "Magic" Mushrooms from the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff. Deliver them to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.
- "Magic" Mushroom (6)
sections.Rewards: You will receive: +1 Cooking Skill
sections.Progress: Were you able to gather any mushrooms?
sections.Completion:
Thank you, ! I'm sure these will impart a simply magical taste to whatever dish they're used in.

What? Stop looking at me like that!

info.name: A Feast for Our Kin
info.previous: A Choice of Allies (Horde) or A Second Ally For the Cause (Horde)

sections.Description:
Ah, the Highmountain tauren. They have been our allies ever since we felled the Legion.

Are you interested in hearing how they joined the Horde? It is quite the tale!

It all began with Baine Bloodhoof and Mayla Highmountain. Baine was hosting a great feast in Thunder Bluff to welcome the Highmountain tauren...
sections.Objectives: Meet Baine Bloodhoof at Thunder Bluff in Mulgore.
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- - 16,450 XP
sections.Completion:
Welcome, .

Mayla speaks of you as a trusted ally. Your presence will surely help convince her of the merits of joining the Horde.
sections.Notes:
Upon acceptance
Baine salutes, leaves the building, mounts a wyvern, and flies away.

For the duration of the quest, Thunder Bluff is phased. Regular NPCs are not present, and only Bluffwatchers patrol the mesas. Fireworks are present. High Rise has several NPCs partying. Mayla, Ebonhorn, and Hamuul Runetotem are standing with Baine having a discussion.

Upon completion
sections.Original version:
Description
We have planned a great feast to welcome the Highmountain tauren to Thunder Bluff. It will be their first visit to the lands of Kalimdor. I have been exchanging missives with their chieftain... I look forward to meeting her.

Will you join us in Mulgore? It would be good for them to see a familiar face that aided their fight against the Legion.

info.name: A Journey to Moonglade
info.start: Sheal Runetotem Shalla Whiteleaf Sesebi Mala Skywatcher

sections.Description:
As you have heard, Moonglade is the home of the Cenarion Circle, the brotherhood of druids. All who dwell there do so in the peace of Cenarius. It is in that spirit that the trainer Loganaar has extended an invitation to visit him in Moonglade.

You will find him in the village of Nighthaven.
sections.Objectives: Speak with Loganaar in Nighthaven.
sections.Completion: Welcome to Moonglade, . I have been looking forward to meeting you.
sections.Progressio:
- A Journey to Moonglade (optional)
- The Circle's Future (Horde)

sections.Description:
A letter magically appears in the lining of your armor. It reads:

"Welcome to Orgrimmar, capital of the Horde!

Meet with a trainer to begin your training. They will help prepare you for your journey across Azeroth and beyond."
sections.Objectives: Meet with a trainer in Orgrimmar.
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 900 XP
- Azeroth Survival Kit
sections.Completion: Ready for your training, ?
sections.Notes: Approach

sections.Description:
It is fortunate that Spiritwalker Ussoh passed along your spirit guide's warning. We were able to evacuate most of the citizens.

This cursed spirit is full of malevolence and hatred. It must be destroyed, !

We attack on your command.
sections.Objectives:
Stop the Malevolent Spirit.
- Malevolent Spirit slain
- Talk to Baine
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- - 17,850 XP
sections.Completion:
You have saved Thunder Bluff, . However, The spirit realm is growing more restless and balance is tipping. We have restored it for now. But how long until the scales are moved again and what is causing it?

I do not have those answer, but I do have another favor to ask.
sections.Notes:
Speak with Baine Bloodhoof:

Once you begin the assault, you will be empowered.

When the Spiritwalkers summon the Ancestor Spirit
After defeating the Malevolent Spirit, the Spirits of Cairne Bloodhoof and Tamaala appear.
Baine runs back and sees the spirits of his parents.
And then, the spirits have vanished. Head to Baine Bloodhoof to turn in.

info.name: Blackfathom Villainy
info.rewards: Inscribed Gravestone Scepter or Ancient Arctic Buckler

sections.Description:
Strength has left me. Your help is needed!

Long ago this site was a great temple of Elune. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted the sacred Moon Well.

Aku'Mai, servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.

The Twilight's Hammer cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.

Slay Kelris and bring his head to Bashana in Thunder Bluff, , please.
sections.Objectives:
Bring the head of Twilight Lord Kelris to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
- Head of Kelris
sections.Rewards:
You will be able to choose one of these rewards:
- Inscribed Gravestone Scepter
- Ancient Arctic Buckler

You will also receive:
- - +200 reputation with Argent Dawn
- +200 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress:
May the Earthmother be with you, .

Peace between the earth and all her people should be our goal. She has a grand plan for nature, and we all have a role to play in that plan.
sections.Completion:
Kelris has eluded the Argent Dawn for some time.

For some time they considered him dead or missing.

By ending his reign you have spared the lives of many innocent people, .

Earthmother be praised! To sacrifice another to a servant of an Old God for personal gain is beyond disgusting!

You have done a great thing this day. Kelris was a creature of evil and sought to bring the world back to a time of chaos by worshipping such creatures as the Old Gods. Thank you, .

info.name: Call of Fire
info.start: Searn Firewarder Xanis Flameweaver Swart Narm Skychaser

sections.Description:
Orgrimmar
Fire be witcha, mon. I see you be strong in da ways of earth already, an' me tinkin' you be ready to talk to Kranal.

Kranal live north of da Crossroads in da Barrens. He be strong in da ways of da elements and can teach ya da ways of fire... if you tink you be ready.

He be easy ta find, just don' go too far--ya go too far an' ya find yerself in da elves' lands.

Thunder Bluff and Mulgore
Long has it been since you were last tested, . You have shown patience thus far in your studies, but the time has come for you to learn more. The time has come for you to learn about destruction... and chaos. The element of fire is yours for the understanding, if you're prepared to pay for it.

Seek out Kranal Fiss in the Barrens. He lives in a small dwelling north of the Crossroads, but be mindful, if you've reached the night elf lands, you've gone too far.

Durotar
It's been some time since you were tested last, . You've been patient thus far in your studies, but it's time for you to learn about greater powers... it's time you learn real power. The element of fire is yours if you're prepared to pay for it.

Seek out Kranal Fiss in the Barrens. He lives in a small dwelling north of the Crossroads, but be mindful, if you've reached the blasted night elf lands, you've gone way too far.
sections.Objectives: Find Kranal Fiss in the Barrens.
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 420 XP
sections.Completion:
Hmmm, sent you to me, did he?

Well then, could always be trusted, so that must mean you're ready to take part of the next sapta--the sapta of fire.

I see it in your eyes already, the burning, the desire. You've tasted power, and now you're ready for more of it. Patience, . Remember what earth taught you. Power and destruction will come easily, but you must still know when to stay your hand.
sections.Notes: - Kranal Fiss can be found at coordinates in the Barrens. The easiest way to find him is to start from the Crossroads and head north along the road. When you come to a fork in the road, take the road leading east towards Durotar. As you head east, look off to the north. You'll come to Grol'Dam Farm and then a tower. Kranal Fiss should be at the base of the tower.
sections.Progression:
- Call of Fire (Horde)
- Call of Fire (2)
- Call of Fire (3)
- Call of Fire (4)
- Call of Fire (5)

sections.Description:
One of Thunder Bluff's most important staples is cornmeal; bowls of corn may be found in nearly every home.

With so many of the local mills under constant attack by harpies, gnolls, reckless mining companies and Earth Mother knows what else, I often ask my students to help with the task of grinding corn into cornmeal.

Would you care to help?
sections.Objectives:
Help the inhabitants of Thunder Bluff make cornmeal by pounding bowls of Corn Kernels.
- Grind Corn Kernels (6)
sections.Rewards: You will receive: +1 Cooking Skill
sections.Progress: Did you help grind cornmeal?
sections.Completion: Much work is required to grind enough cornmeal for everyone's needs. Thank you for your help, .

title: Craving Crayfish

sections.Description:
One of the great delicacies of Mulgore is the crayfish that dwell in our lakes and streams. They are particularly popular during weddings or the celebration of a birth.

Would you help me catch some of these crafty crustaceans for the cooking pots of Thunder Bluff?

You can fish them up from Stonebull Lake, or simply dive in and grab them.
sections.Objectives:
Kah Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff wants 10 Stonebull Crayfish from Stonebull Lake in Mulgore. 
- Stonebull Crayfish (10)
sections.Rewards: You will receive: , +1 Fishing
sections.Progress: Crayfish are so tasty. Have you caught many?
sections.Completion:
Ah, so many crayfish!

Did you fish these up? Or simply swim after them?

Well, no matter. Excellent work, .
sections.Notes: This quest is a requirement for the achievement Fish or Cut Bait: Thunder Bluff.

links: Fish or Cut Bait: Thunder Bluff

sections.Description:
Even though you're trick-or-treating for a sick child, you still need to perform a trick for the treat! We can't very well change the tradition, now can we...

I believe the cost of a piece of marzipan nowadays is to bust out and DANCE! That's right, let me see your moves! Dance for me, and I'll give you some tasty marzipan!
sections.Objectives:
Do a dance emote at Innkeeper Pala, and in exchange you'll receive Thunder Bluff Marzipan!
- Dance for Innkeeper Pala
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- Thunder Bluff Marzipan
sections.Progress: You know how to dance, don't you? Try by putting your right foot in... then your right foot out... your right foot in... shake it all about...
sections.Completion:
You're quite the dancing machine, !

Here's your treat for being such a good sport. Happy Hallow's End, and give my best to your sick little friend! I hope they get better soon.

sections.Description:
The Old Gods have inflicted one of their faceless ones upon Thunder Bluff. The fiend desecrates my people's city!

We must fight together to rid this place of such filth.

I believe that destroying this herald will drive our enemies from Mulgore. May our weapons strike true, !
sections.Objectives:
Defeat Qy'telek, Herald of Uul'gyneth
- Kill Qy'telek
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- - 16,450 XP
sections.Progress: This herald of the Old Gods must be stopped.
sections.Completion: A fine kill, . My people can clean up from here.

sections.Description:
Deadmire is an ancient crocolisk in Dustwallow marsh. And it is his time to die.

Old bones grind as he pulls his huge body through the swamp, and although he still moves with the strength and speed of youth, his aging body tortures the great spirit within it, a spirit whose flame will not waver.

Yet now he lives in constant, maddening pain. You must end the life of this noble creature, . You must lead Deadmire to peace.
sections.Objectives:
Bring Deadmire's Tooth to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
- Deadmire's Tooth
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 4,590 XP
-
sections.Progress: Do you have the tooth of Deadmire, ? Have you ended the creature's suffering?
sections.Completion:
Very good, .

I am sure the hunt was not easy, but it is good to know the beast's pain has finally ended.
sections.Notes:
The path of the hunter is one that renounces mindless killing and instead teaches spiritual union with the prey. It is said that hunters who defeat their victim honourably become one with it, acquiring some of its abilities and reaching a deeper understanding of the world of nature surrounding themselves. The path of the hunter is also, at times, the path of mercy.

Deadmire, an old and massive crocolisk, wanders the shores of swamps in the Dustwallow Marsh. Although still immensely strong compared to its kind, age has not been kind to this ancient creature - it now moves its massive body slowly, suffering excruciating pain in its broken bones and weakened limbs. Those seeking to advance in the ways of the hunter are said to be searching for this noble crocolisk, charged with the grim and honourable task of ending its agony.

Also, you may find Deadmire around an island that is just north of Stonemaul Ruins. Start at Stonemaul Ruins and travel north up the river until you find him, he is a big white crocolisk.

sections.Description:
Dokin and Laha have been hard at work helping celebrants learn about the traditional Pilgrim's Bounty feast and how to make dishes out of all the ingredients we harvest at this time of year. I've been trying to keep the tables stocked with as many of the dishes as I can, but we're running low on pumpkin pie.

Would you be able to get some for us? If you want to make the pies yourself, you'll need to buy ripe Tirisfal pumpkins from the Pilgrim's Bounty vendor outside the Undercity.
sections.Objectives:
Bring 20 pieces of Pumpkin Pie to Mahara Goldwheat at the feasting area outside Thunder Bluff.
- Pumpkin Pie (20)
sections.Progress: How are those pies coming along?
sections.Completion: These are great! Thank you for helping, .

info.name: Gathering Leather
info.rewards: Animal Skin Belt or Double-Layered Gloves or Animal Scale Belt or Mulit-Scaled Gloves

sections.Description:
Greetings, young one. You have a gleam in your eye; I can tell you are eager to venture back to the plains for the hunt. May you bring honor to your clan!

I work with the skins of beasts, fashioning them into clothes and armor for the people of Thunder Bluff.

If you hunt beasts and bring me their skins, then I will fashion something for you.
sections.Objectives:
Bring 12 pieces of Light Leather to Veren Tallstrider in Thunder Bluff.
- Light Leather (12)
sections.Rewards:
You will also receive:
- 250 XP
- +350 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress: Hello again. Have you been hunting? Do you have skins for me?
sections.Completion:
Ah, these are very nice pieces. They'll make fine leather goods.

Here, . Take this in trade...

info.name: Gnomish Engineering
info.start: Springspindle Fizzlegear Lilliam Sparkspindle Roxxik Engineer Palehoof

sections.Description:
A skilled engineer can choose ONE specialization, and I can teach you the ways of gnomish engineering.

You look like you know what you're doing, but I'll need some samples of your work. Bring me six mithril tubes, an accurate scope, and two advanced target dummies.

Submit these items to an engineering trainer in any of the capital cities and you'll be an official gnomish engineer with access to all the schematics!
sections.Objectives:
Bring 6 Mithril Tubes, an Accurate Scope, and 2 Advanced Target Dummies to an engineering trainer in any capital city.
- Advanced Target Dummy (2)
- Accurate Scope
- Mithril Tube (6)
sections.Rewards: You will learn: Gnomish Engineering
sections.Progress: Once I receive your crafted engineering items for my review, you can become a certified gnomish engineer, granting you unlimited access to gnomish engineer schematics.
sections.Completion: Today is the day you become a real engineer, . Don't worry about all those messy bombs and explosives, because it's time to shine!

info.name: Goblin Engineering
info.start: Lilliam Sparkspindle Springspindle Fizzlegear Roxxik Engineer Palehoof

sections.Description:
A skilled engineer can choose ONE specialization, and I know the secrets of goblin engineering.

You look like you're ready to blow things up, but I'll need some samples of your work. Bring me twenty big iron bombs, twenty sticks of solid dynamite, and five explosive sheep.

Submit these items to an engineering trainer in any of the capital cities and you'll be an official goblin engineer with access to all the schematics!
sections.Objectives:
Bring 20 Big Iron Bombs, 20 Solid Dynamite, and 5 Explosive Sheep to an engineering trainer in any capital city.
- Big Iron Bomb (20)
- Solid Dynamite (20)
- Explosive Sheep (5)
sections.Rewards: You will learn: Goblin Engineering
sections.Progress: Once I receive your crafted engineering items for my review, I will grant you the knowledge required to join the exclusive club of goblin engineers!
sections.Completion:
It appears you are indeed ready for proper training. I dub you Goblin Engineer !

You'll be able to access any goblin engineer for some diabolical creations. Have fun and try not to blow your face off.

sections.Description:
Have a wondrous Winter Veil, friend! Be sure to say hello to Greatfather Winter, who's currently in Orgrimmar! If you've been nice this year, you'll receive wondrous treats on the day of the Feast of Winter Veil. Be sure to tell him what you hope to get this year! 

Also, be sure to stock up on treats to give those who've been nice this year. We have a great selection to choose from. Fresh from our farm to your plate - it's Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness!
sections.Objectives: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.
sections.Completion:
Ho ho hello. I am Great-father Winter, and I - courtesy of the fine folks of Smokywood Pastures... "Fresh from our farm to your plate, it's Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness" - would like to wish you a fantastic Feast of Winter Veil.

If you've been good this year, maybe you will receive treats from Smokywood Pastures as your treat for the Feast of Winter Veil. Huzzah.
sections.Notes:
There are three quest givers who can give this quest:
- In Orgrimmar, it is Kaymard Copperpinch (53,66) in the Valley of Strength
- In Thunder Bluff, it is Whulwert Copperpinch (43,58) on the lower rise
- In Undercity, it is Nardstrum Copperpinch
sections.Progression:
- Great-father Winter is Here!
- Treats for Great-father Winter

info.name: Heeding the Call
info.start: Gennia Runetotem Innkeeper Gryshka Innkeeper Pala

sections.Description:
Excuse me, friend...

It has come to my attention that Turak Runetotem has put out word that he wishes to speak with you. It seems that your training as a druid is about to take on a new life, and he will be training you personally. Turak is one of the Arch Druid's assistants; he is known as a wise and patient druid, and he should teach you well.

He is located in Thunder Bluff, inside the Cenarion Circle's main tent on the Elder Rise.
sections.Objectives: Speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 85 XP
- +25 reputation with the Cenarion Circle
sections.Completion:
I am glad you found your way here today, young druid. The time has come for you to take a large step into a much larger world.

Inside each of Cenarius' children is the call to serve nature. Animals and plants are our friends as well as our charges. We choose to devote our lives as preservers of balance for their sakes as well as our own. Your first step into this world will be to learn of the ways of the bear, and to learn strength of body and heart.

Ready yourself!
sections.Notes: There are three identical version started from Gennia Runetotem in Bloodhoof Village of Mulgore, from Innkeeper Gryshka in Orgrimmar, or from Innkeeper Pala in Thunder Bluff. Only one of them can be done.

sections.Description:
The kodo beasts of Mulgore are strong and sturdy—traits much respected among us. If you are skilled in leatherworking and wish the knowledge to make a Kodo Hide Bag, then bring me supplies for my trade.

Do this, and I will share my knowledge with you.
sections.Objectives:
Bring 4 Light Leather and 4 Coarse Thread to Veren Tallstrider in Thunder Bluff. 
- Light Leather (4)
- Coarse Thread (4)
sections.Rewards:
You will also receive:
- 420 XP (or at level 70)
- +75 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress: Do you have my supplies, ?
sections.Completion: Ah, good. Thank you, . My heart swells with pride to see youths interested in the craft of leatherworking.

info.name: Mazzranache
info.rewards: Cliff Runner Boots or Plains Hunter Wristguards

sections.Description:
My grandfather told me stories about his battles with a strider named Mazzranache. He told me of its demonic red eyes, razor-sharp talons and venomous bite.

As fortune would have it, while traveling across the plains, I encountered it, and it took a nasty bite from my shoulder. He was as terrible as my grandfather described. I will need some hard-to-find animal parts to clean the infection from his bite: a wolf heart, cougar femur, plainstrider scale and swoop gizzard.

Hurry, time is of the essence.
sections.Objectives:
Bring a Prairie Wolf Heart, Flatland Cougar Femur, Plainstrider Scale and Swoop Gizzard to Maur Raincaller at Bloodhoof Village.
- Prairie Wolf Heart
- Flatland Cougar Femur
- Plainstrider Scale
- Swoop Gizzard
sections.Rewards:
You will also receive:
- 700 XP
- +100 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress:
My fever grows worse and I find my mind drifting into delirious nightmares... I should have known that I wouldn't be able to handle a beast my grandfather was unable to defeat...

Do you have the ingredients for the remedy? I fear if I do not clean the infection soon, it will be the death of me.
sections.Completion:
Ah, thank you, . Using the items you brought me, I will be able to create the remedy I need to stop the spread of the infection and, eventually, cure it completely. I owe you my life in thanks.

But I'll never forget that screeching call when Mazzranache came upon me, the blaze of color as its beak descended...

Be wary on your travels.

info.name: Meet With Avaros Dawnglaive
info.start: Aponi Brightmane Champion Cyssa Dawnrose Champion Bachi

sections.Description:
Avaros Dawnglaive sends word from Orgrimmar -- he wishes to speak with you when you're in the city. I needn't remind you that Avaros is an honored member of our order and his requests should not be ignored.

Next time you are in Orgrimmar, travel to The Barracks in the Valley of Honor and speak with him.
sections.Objectives: Speak with Avaros Dawnglaive at The Barracks in Orgrimmar.
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 150 XP
- +10 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Completion: I've heard much of your contributions to the Horde, .
sections.Progression:
- Meet With Avaros Dawnglaive (tauren) (optional)
- A True Sunwalker

sections.Description: I just received a scroll for you from Orgrimmar, . It's from Feenix Arcshine, one of the mage trainers there. He wants you to meet with him at The Barracks in the Valley of Honor.
sections.Objectives: Speak with Feenix Arcshine at The Barracks in Orgrimmar.
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 350 XP
- +10 reputation with Orgrimmar
sections.Completion: The Horde needs your help in the battle against our enemies.
sections.Progression:
- Meet with Feenix Arcshine (optional)
- The Pyromancer's Grimoire (Horde)

info.name: Moonglade Calls
info.start: Mathrengyl Bearwalker Celestine of the Harvest Sheal Runetotem Shalla Whiteleaf Sesebi Mala Skywatcher Harene Plainwalker

sections.Description: I have received word that our brothers in Moonglade have requested your help, . You should travel there and speak with Loganaar in Nighthaven. He will tell you all you need to know.
sections.Objectives: Travel to Moonglade and speak with Loganaar in Nighthaven.
sections.Completion: It's good to see you again, . I wish I could say that I had happy news.
sections.Progression:
- Moonglade Calls (optional)
- The Breath of Cenarius

sections.Description:
I am often asked, "Aska, who is making all this Mulgore spice bread?!"

It is a reasonable question. Our fine and noble bread is traded in countless settlements in the most far-away lands, even by our staunchest foes. IT'S JUST THAT GOOD.

And the answer...?

It is "YOU." Please take this packet of Mulgore spices and use it to turn bland, boring spice bread into MULGORE spice bread!
sections.Objectives:
Use Mulgore Spices with Spice Bread to create 5 Fresh Mulgore Spice Bread (you may make your own Spice Bread or use someone else's). Deliver the bread to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.
- Fresh Mulgore Spice Bread (5)
- Mulgore Spices (provided)
sections.Rewards: You will receive: +1 Cooking Skill
sections.Progress: Have you baked that Mulgore spice bread yet?
sections.Completion:
Ooo, that bread smells delicious. You are quite the baker, .

Who knows how far these exquisite loaves will go... I hear it's even popular among the draenei of the Azuremyst Isles!

sections.Description:
Even the novice cook knows that a great dish begins with great ingredients.

I have standing orders with merchants throughout Thunder Bluff, but I'd like to see how well you do at selecting the very best of what they have to offer.

Please make the rounds and gather perfect portions of meat, fish, vegetables and herbs from local merchant stalls.
sections.Objectives:
Obtain four "perfect portions" from merchant stalls around Thunder Bluff. Deliver the ingredients to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.
- Succulent Sweet Potatoes
- Savory Spices
- Fresh-Caught Fish
- Fresh-Hunted Fowl
sections.Rewards: You will receive: +2 Cooking Skill
sections.Progress: Have you gathered all the necessary ingredients?
sections.Completion:
Mmmhmmm. Yes. Well done!

I could not have chosen better myself.

sections.Description:
The Shu'halo use pine nuts in so MANY dishes: meat, fish, vegetables, even baked into breads or sprinkled over sweet pastries.

The Earth Mother has blessed us in that the very BEST pine nuts come from the trees upon these very mesas. Simply gather pine cones and toast them over a cooking fire to release the nuts within.

Would you please be so kind as to gather some? There are hardly ever enough to go around...
sections.Objectives:
Obtain 30 Pine Nuts by toasting Mulgore Pine Cones from Thunder Bluff. Deliver the nuts to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.
- Pine Nut (30)
sections.Rewards: You will receive: +1 Cooking Skill
sections.Progress: Have you found many of those tasty pine nuts?
sections.Completion:
You work so quickly!

I'll see that these are distributed to the various chefs and bakers of Thunder Bluff.

Thank you!

title: Pond Predators

sections.Description:
A well-meaning goblin visitor introduced Azshara snakeheads to our waters and now they're overrunning the pond.

Please, if you can catch some of these voracious predatory fish before they eat every smallfish and mud snapper in Thunder Bluff, I'd be terribly grateful.
sections.Objectives:
Kah Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff wants 8 Azshara Snakehead fish from the Thunder Bluff pond. 
- Azshara Snakehead (8)
sections.Rewards: You will receive: , +1 Fishing
sections.Progress: Have you caught any Azshara snakeheads, yet?
sections.Completion: Good work, . It's up to all of Thunder Bluff's fishers to keep this vicious creature out of Mulgore's waters.
sections.Notes: This quest is a requirement for the achievement Fish or Cut Bait: Thunder Bluff.

links: Fish or Cut Bait: Thunder Bluff

sections.Description:
You may remember the day Thunder Bluff was attacked. It was your efforts and your guide who saved us.

Now we take time to honor our ancestors and give thanks for the path they have set for us.

Bring this offering to the cliffs overlooking Thunder Bluff and give thanks to your guide and all our ancestors.

A simple gesture to commemorate our past. This is our way.
sections.Objectives:
Deliver the offering to your spirit guide on the cliffs overlooking Thunder Bluff.
- Offering presented
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- - 17,850 XP
sections.Completion: On this day we remember and give thanks to the ones who have come before us. May the Earth Mother guide you.
sections.Notes:
The offering is located on a tall cliff overlooking Thunder Bluff from the southwest. Right-click the object to present the offering.
The tauren adventurer's spirit guide manifests and proceeds to reveal itself as Chieftain Hototo.
The chieftain fades away.

Turn the quest in to Baine Bloodhoof at Thunder Bluff.

sections.Description:
Spiritwalker Ebonhorn remains in great danger. He and Mayla have returned to Highmountain, but I believe they still need our aid.

Let us journey to Thunder Totem and do whatever we can to mend Ebonhorn. Perhaps our deeds will strengthen the bond between our peoples.
sections.Objectives: Meet Mayla Highmountain at Thunder Totem in Highmountain.
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- - 16,450 XP
sections.Completion:
Ebonhorn has spoken of ancient wards that must be maintained in Highmountain. Wards that hold back a great darkness.

This may be tied to the evil that grips him now.

We must hope that Spiritwalker Graysky can tell us more.
sections.Notes: Upon accepting, Baine mounts a wyvern and flies away. The NPCs that were partying at the beginning of the questline are now partying again, along with the fighting guards and void creatures and their void-trapped counterparts in the tents. So is Baine duplicated in his tent.

info.name: Return to Krog
info.rewards: Fleshripper (dagger) or Crimson Barbut or Serrated Gladius

sections.Description:
I hope I've been helpful to you and I'm sorry I can't offer more information. My apprentices and I produce such a large volume of arms and armor that it's almost impossible to recall details about any individual piece.

Not only do we outfit the braves defending tauren lands, but the Grimtotems have a particular fondness for my work. A seasoned warrior knows good work when he sees it.
sections.Objectives: Speak with Krog at Brackenwall Village.
sections.Completion: He actually said that the Grimtotems are his biggest customers? Mosarn gave us more help than he knows. With this much pointing toward the Grimtotems, I think we just found our first suspects.

sections.Description:
You have passed the Rites of the Earthmother and earned your place in Thunder Bluff.

But in order to maintain the spot that you strived so hard to achieve, you must continue to prove your worth to your people.

We are hunters, . Down below in Mulgore there is a mighty kodo named Arra'chea. Show me your skills in the ways of tracking and hunting by bringing me the Horn of Arra'chea.
sections.Objectives:
Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff wants you to bring him the Horn of Arra'chea.
- Horn of Arra'chea
sections.Rewards:
- You will receive:
- Kodo Hunter's Leggings
- 1250 XP
- +350 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress: Have you tracked down Arra'chea yet?
sections.Completion:
Well done! A fine kill that was.

I will send a gathering party to collect the carcass so we can retrieve the hide and meat.

You have done a great deed for your people, .
sections.Notes: - Arra'chea travels in a circular path northeast of Thunder Bluff. He spawns at the northeast corner of Thunder Bluff and following the path slowly in a clockwise direction.

sections.Description:
A dark force has descended upon us. I refuse to believe that the Highmountain are behind it.

The cacophony out there is disturbingly familiar. Could it be... 

No! The minions of the Old Gods are attacking! We must fight for Thunder Bluff, !
sections.Objectives:
Slay 4 Dark Tendrils and 12 Shadows of Uul in Thunder Bluff.
- Dark Tendril slain (4)
- Shadow of Uul slain (12)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- - 16,450 XP
sections.Progress: For the Old Gods to manifest even these fledgling minions is troubling.
sections.Completion:
The Old Gods are known for subversion and duplicity. To attack so brazenly...

Whatever they seek, they want it badly.
sections.Notes:
- The central mesas of Thunder Bluff are phased to be under attack. Many more friendly NPCs reappear, now being trapped by the Void. Some that are regularly seen outside their buildings and tents are now placed inside.
- Baine will follow you. His generic name for other nearby players is Honor Guard.

sections.Description:
I have a stash of extremely rare leathers, or... rather, I did.

I don't know how, but the Venture Company must have heard how valuable my collection was because they stole it!

And THEN they had the audacity to leave a note offering to sell it back to me for 1,000 gold! As the "former owner", I'm able to "best appreciate the value of their new acquisition."

The note states they'll be in the bluffs to the East until someone buys them.

However you get the skins, consider them yours.
sections.Objectives:
Retrieve the Rare Hides.
- Rare Hides
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- - 17,850 XP
sections.Progress: How was she?
sections.Completion:
Bah! Wretched goblins and their lust of coin!

I... Am sorry you had to see that. I just find it so infuriating when our fight is made harder so one of those green-skinned runts can steal your last copper.
sections.Notes:
Fly northeast out of Thunder Bluff until just shy of Red Rocks. Keep a lookout for Verd Twiceswindle and four Venture Lackeys. There is a chest behind and to the side of Verd, but it is locked. You can choose to either pay off the thieves or kill them.

Verd Twiceswindle
Heeey, you look like a smart, young rube.

How wouldja like to find yourself in some fine leathers?

The cow gave you the run down, eh? Fine, a mark's a mark. Doesn't matter to me who gets the goods.

You want what's in the chest, just hand over a one-time payment of 1,250 gold, and they're all yours!

Correct! It WAS 1,000 gold.

But, she must have forgotten to include my, ahem, "broker's fees".

1,250 is the offer. Take it or leave it.

Although with our limited supply, and this sudden demand on the market, it seems it would be fiscally responsible to, ehh, increase the price further.

Do you want to purchase Sheza's Rare Hides for: 

Look, ya seem like a nice .

Either pay up and be on ya way or the Venture Co. "Asset Recovery" team will have to go through your bags. Ta, you know, make sure you didn't "accidentally" acquire anything that rightfully belongs to Venture Co.

And I gotta warn ya, you're gonna be surprised by the amount of stuff we'll find in your bag that belongs to us.

Kapish?

[Note: Selecting this option circles back to the same response for "Sheza told me you were asking for 1,000."]

Choose to fight
The Horde adventurer fights and kills the group, looting Verd's Chest Key to unlock the chest.

Quest completion

title: Shiny Baubles

sections.Description:
One of a fisher's most simple and effective tools is the shiny bauble; affixed to a line, even the most novice angler has a chance at a catch.

With all the fishing going on of late, though, Thunder Bluff is in woefully short supply!

Might I ask you to collect shiny stones from around the base of the central rise? Bring them to Nahari Cloudchaser so that she might craft more shiny baubles with them.
sections.Objectives:
Nahari Cloudchaser in Thunder Bluff wants 20 Shiny Stones from around the central rise's base. 
- Shiny Stone (20)
sections.Rewards: You will receive: , +2 Fishing
sections.Progress: Did you happen to bring me any shiny stones?
sections.Completion:
My, those are some very lovely stones! They'll make perfect shiny baubles, thank you.

Here... Kah told me you'd be by with the stones, and to give this to you upon your arrival.
sections.Notes: This quest is a requirement for the achievement Fish or Cut Bait: Thunder Bluff.

links: Fish or Cut Bait: Thunder Bluff

sections.Description: I sense in you a hidden talent for the subtle arts, shaman. Use this mask to infilrate the nearby Venture Company mine and steal their supplies. It may not seem like a convincing disguise, but a skilled rogue can slip past any guard with naught but a winning smile and a cunning distraction. I believe this capability lies within you as well.
sections.Objectives:
Sneak into the Venture Company mine southeast of Thunder Bluff and collect 5 Seaforium Mining Charges from carts of blasting supplies, then return them to Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff.
- Seaforium Mining Charge (5)
- Venture Co Disguise (provided)
sections.Progress: We'll need to work on your stealth skills, shaman. I heard you approaching as soon as you set foot on the mesa.
sections.Completion: Hmm... perhaps disguises are not your strength.

sections.Description:
I speak to you from your future, when the Horde faces threats you cannot imagine. Since the others cannot see me, I rely on you to learn my skills and pass them to the tribe.

Maybe your skills lie with poisons, not disguises. The Harpies to the north nest in a tree which produces a resin of potent toxicity. Gather the fallen cones around the nests, then crush them into a salve. When applied to a blade this salve will sear your opponent's wounds into their flesh and turn their blood to salt.
sections.Objectives:
Gather 8 Windfury Cones north of Thunder Bluff, use them with the Mortar and Pestle, then return to Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff with the result.
- Pine Salve
- Mortar and Pestle (Season of Discovery) (provided)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- Pine Nut Butter
sections.Progress: Be careful with the salve once you are finished, shaman. Even skin contact could be quite painful.
sections.Completion:
Shaman, this is not the venomous salve I asked for. What you have brought me is pine nut butter. Are you sure you followed my instructions?

This will be of far more use spread on some spice bread than on a dagger. Although you would be quite formidable against a foe with a nut allergy.

sections.Description:
I have one last idea that may lead us to success. I still feel there is hidden talent in you, but let us try and coax it out with a less direct approach.

Go and procure a Raw Brilliant Smallfish, then bring it back here. Use these daggers to clean and fillet it. Do not think too hard - do what comes naturally.
sections.Objectives:
Buy or catch a :Raw Brilliant Smallfish, then use the Knife Set to fillet it in front of Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff.
- Fish Chunks
- Knife Set (provided)
sections.Rewards:
The following will be cast on you:
- Dual wield
- Engrave Gloves - Lava Lash (shaman rune)
sections.Progress: Do you have something for me?
sections.Completion:
That was quite a display, shaman. Not the rogueish precision I hoped for, but you possess an impressive ambidexterity.

I see now that you will not be the one to train my people in the subtle arts, but there is one thing I can teach you. Good luck on your travels, shaman. The Horde will need heroes like you.

sections.Description:
This is worse than I feared.

The people of Bloodhoof Village are in grave danger. Even the brave young tauren who train there are woefully unprepared for the danger that is coming.

Do what you can to stop this threat. I will go to Thunder Bluff to warn the High Chieftain.
sections.Objectives:
Travel to Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore and stop the spirit attack.
- Travel to Bloodhoof Village
- Save the people of Bloodhoof Village
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- - 17,850 XP
sections.Completion: You heard the horn, ! We are in dire need of your help.
sections.Notes:
On accept, The Spiritwalkers stand up.

The trio heads out. You must head to Bloodhoof Village. Once you arrive, it was filled with Necrofiends and Malicious Spirits who have been popping out of Spirit Portals and trapping the Kodos.

To fill up the bar,
- kill Malicious Spirits and Necrofiends
- interact with Spirit Portals, Trapped Kodo, and Bloodhoof Villagers.

Once you fill that bar to 100%, Baine Bloodhoof gives everyone a distress call.
Head to Thunder Bluff and meet up with Baine Bloodhoof.

sections.Description:
I have prepared leather goods for Varg to sell at the Bloodhoof Village. Will you bring them to him?

If you have already been to Bloodhoof Village and spoken to their wind rider master, then you can fly one of our Thunder Bluff wind riders back to him.

Take the leather goods to Tal, our wind rider master in Thunder Bluff, and speak with him to arrange transport to Bloodhoof Village.
sections.Objectives:
Bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Tal in Thunder Bluff.
- Ahanu's Leather Goods (provided)
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 50 XP
- +25 reputation with Thunder Bluff
sections.Progress: Greetings, . What can I do for you?
sections.Completion: You need to take this to Bloodhoof Village, eh? That's not a problem. If you've already been there and spoken to Tak, then you can take one of my wind riders back to him.

info.name: Thank Your Guide
info.rewards: Heritage of the Shu'halo, Ancient Tauren Talisman

sections.Description:
The balance has been restored, and Thunder Bluff is safe. Thank you.

We owe our victory to your spirit's guidance. We must honor the old ways by giving thanks to the ones who came before us.

To the southwest lies a beautiful vista where my father once took me. It would be a fitting place to reflect upon all that has transpired.

Please take this offering there to honor our ancestors.
sections.Objectives:
Deliver the offering to your spirit guide on the cliffs southwest of Thunder Bluff.
- Offering presented
sections.Rewards:
You will learn: Heritage of the Shu'halo

You will also receive:
- Ancient Tauren Talisman
- - 22,300 XP
sections.Completion: vestments and a ceremonial totem.>
sections.Notes:
On accept, Baine Bloodhoof walks out of his tent.

The Tauren cheered to the player. Head to the cliff and present the offering. Chieftain Hototo appears.

sections.Description:
There exists a hellish gate that has loomed silent for years, but it is silent no longer.

All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to the Blasted Lands. Visit the Zeppelin Master outside of the city gates of Orgrimmar and ride to Grom'gol Base Camp. From there, speak to Thysta to arrange a flight to Stonard.

Report to Warlord Dar'toon at once. He awaits you before the Dark Portal...
sections.Objectives:
Find Watch Warlord Dar'toon at the Blasted Lands. He awaits your arrival before the Dark Portal.
- Visit Snurk Bucksquick, the Zeppelin Master
- Speak to Thysta at Grom'gol Base Camp
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- 9,550 XP
sections.Completion: Welcome to the nightmare!
sections.Notes:
On accept
Speaking with Thysta

sections.Description: The dread beast Aku'mai lies dead. Hidden amongst the viscera and gore of its swollen corpse is an enormous iridescent pearl teeming with raw Void energy.
sections.Objectives:
Bring the Perfect Blackfathom Pearl to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
- Perfect Blackfathom Pearl#Horde
sections.Rewards:
You will also receive:
- +200 reputation with Thunder Bluff
- +200 reputation with Orgrimmar
- +200 reputation with Undercity
sections.Progress: , what news do you have from Blackfathom?
sections.Completion:
The servant of the Old Gods, Aku'mai, is dead. You have done a mighty service for the denizens of Kalimdor with this deed.

The pearl may also be the key to much greater understanding of the nature of the Void and its effect on our world. It must be studied at once. Walk with the Earth Mother, .

sections.Description: This set of three Horde-only quests describes the aftermath of Magatha Grimtotem's failed attempt to befriend the troggs in Ragefire Chasm. It consists of a two-part quest and a technically independent third quest and gives a nice boost of XP and Rep to low level characters.
sections.Testing an Enemy's Strength:
Testing an Enemy's Strength

As you reach the adequate level (level 9, in fact), you could chat with Rahauro, servant of Magatha. He will tell you that, beneath the city of Orgrimmar, stout creatures known as troggs started coming to the surface from deep below the lava filled tunnels. In her ever-benevolence, Magatha sought to make peace with the creatures, but they turned on her diplomats, killing them. She will not allow such treatment of the tauren people and now consider the creatures a threat to all of the Horde. So you receive the task to Search Orgrimmar for Ragefire Chasm, then kill 8 Ragefire Troggs and 8 Ragefire Shaman before returning to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.
sections.The Lost Satchel:
Searching for the Lost Satchel

Magatha has also heard word that one of her servants, Maur Grimtotem, found something peculiar while in the Chasm, but he never made it out to show her what. She'd like Maur's body found - if it still exists - and any signs of what he found while attempting to speak to the troggs. You have to Search Ragefire Chasm for Maur Grimtotem's corpse and search it for any items of interest.

His corpse can be found on the floor in front of Oggleflint, a level 16 elite trogg. Enter the instance and follow the path to the end where it comes to a T and branches off in several directions. Take the closest path to the right which goes up hill for a short distance. When you reach the top at the landing look to the left and you will see an entrance to a small room where you find the body of Maura Runetotem on the ground with three Troggs surrounding it. 

Returning the Lost Satchel

You get the Grimtotem Satchel, Take the Grimtotem Satchel to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff. The complete quests are finished.
sections.Rewards:
If you complete all three quests you will get the following rewards:

You can choose from the following 2 items:
- Featherbead Bracers
- Savannah Bracers

You receive (from quest turn-ins only):
- - 3225 XP
- 1000 reputation with Thunder Bluff
