sections.Description:
Saurfang... I...

...Thrall will wish to honor Saurfang's sacrifice. And so shall the rest of us.

Recall our forces. Let them know what has transpired. Tell them that the great warrior Varok Saurfang is dead and that the warchief has abandoned us.

Speak to Baine when you arrive in Thunder Bluff. You will find him on the Elder Rise. I am certain he will want to pay his respects as well.

Let us stand as a united Horde once more.
sections.Objectives:
Inform Baine Bloodhoof of what has transpired.
- Speak with Baine Bloodhoof
- Return to Lor'themar before the gates of Orgrimmar.
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- - 17,850 XP
sections.Progress: He earned the warrior's death he always sought. There is honor in that.
sections.Completion: Saurfang's death will not be in vain.
sections.Notes:
On accept:
Fly to Thunder Bluff. Baine is at the tent on the Elder Rise, with Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem, Ji Firepaw, and Mayla Highmountain.

Speak to Baine:

Return to Lor'themar outside Orgrimmar.

title: The Race to Restock

sections.Description:
Thunder Bluff's fishing pond is being overrun with voracious Azshara snakeheads; there are hardly any smallfish or mud snappers left.

We already have fishers trying to kill as many snakeheads as they can, but can you assist us in our restocking efforts?

If you could gather some fish from Stonebull Lake and bring them here to Thunder Bluff, I would be very grateful.
sections.Objectives:
Kah Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff wants 2 Randy Smallfish and 2 Amorous Mud Snappers from Stonebull Lake in Mulgore. 
- Randy Smallfish (2)
- Amorous Mud Snapper (2)
sections.Rewards: You will receive: , +1 Fishing
sections.Progress: Did you bring those fish from Stonebull Lake, yet?
sections.Completion:
Your help is much appreciated, .

Hopefully these fish will go a long way towards restocking our fishing pond.
sections.Notes: This quest is a requirement for the achievement Fish or Cut Bait: Thunder Bluff.

links: Fish or Cut Bait: Thunder Bluff

title: The Ring's the Thing

sections.Description:
One of the Forsaken from the Pools of Vision came to me and said he'd lost his ring to a blind cavefish in the waters there.

Or perhaps it was his finger. It was hard to tell; his jaw did not move and his Orcish was no better than mine.

In any case, I thought it would be a kind gesture towards our unusual visitors to catch and gut cavefish until the ring - or finger - was found.

Would you help?
sections.Objectives:
Fish up a Blind Cavefish from the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff. Once you catch a cavefish, fillet it and check if it swallowed the ring.
- Poshken's Ring
sections.Rewards: You will receive: , +1 Fishing
sections.Progress: You haven't seen a ring about, have you? I think one of the cavefish might have swallowed it...
sections.Completion:
You found my ring, did you? I'm most grateful.

To be honest, I've no idea why I keep the thing. I'm not even certain how I acquired it... I suppose I am simply a creature of habit.

Still, as I said, I am grateful. Say... I found these things while searching for it myself. Perhaps they'd be of some use to you?
sections.Notes: This quest is a requirement for the achievement Fish or Cut Bait: Thunder Bluff.

links: Fish or Cut Bait: Thunder Bluff

sections.Description:
As you know, the spiritwalkers commune with our ancestors and maintain balance within the spirit realm. It is a sacred duty that links our present to our past.

But lately the spiritwalkers have been troubled by visions of chaos and turmoil. Of a rising darkness.

They tell me that the spirits have whispered your name. We are unsure why, but Spiritwalker Ussoh means to find out.

Seek Ussoh on Fargaze Mesa to the south. Good luck, . I believe you may need it.
sections.Objectives: Speak with Spiritwalker Ussoh at Fargaze Mesa in Camp Narache.
sections.Rewards:
You will receive:
- - 1,800 XP
sections.Completion:
Hmph. I expected you sooner. 

No matter. Have a seat.

sections.Description:
Filthy scum! Leaves me for his damn crusade. Because "the Light is the most important thing we have against the threats the undead pose."

Well, what about his children?! What about ME?! Night after night I sat patiently waiting for him... always second to his blasted duty!

Well, witness what "justice" brings you, ! He's dead and I'm bearing the very thing he was trying to stop!

Take this piece of junk and put it on his tomb at the Sepulcher. I want nothing to do with it anymore... or him!
sections.Objectives:
Place Clarice's Pendant on Yuriv's Tomb in Silverpine.
- Clarice's Pendant (Provided)
sections.Progress:
The stone is cold to the touch, but has obviously been abused. Trash litters the area; nicks and gashes decorate the relief atop the coffin; and the foliage around the grave has started to grow over the site.

No one cares for whoever is buried here, especially not any victims of the plague.
sections.Completion:
You place the worthless pendant on the grave, and the gemstone within the setting seems to dull noticeably.

As you stand to leave, you look down at the pendant; it lies lifelessly over the hands of the relief sculpted into the top of the coffin. Your thoughts are interrupted by a stiff, cool breeze passing over the Sepulcher. For a moment everything around you is silent.
Your spirit burns with life, young <class>. I accept the homage you pay, and offer in return this token...
